    This facilitates faster deployment, lower costs, and a smooth transition to full B2B e-commerce.

The portal benefits CIOs, sales leaders, and customer service managers. CIOs can reduce total cost of ownership resulting from the integration between their sales and core ERP applications; sales leaders gain improved customer engagement and streamlined operations; and customer service managers will appreciate the reduction in routine inquiries. Additionally, partners can add and build additional features for the portal like claims management, returns, service tickets, and sales quotes, driving new revenue streams and additional customers benefits.  SAP B2B Self-Service Portal is available now.

SAP Revenue Growth Management Innovation Supports CPG Promotions Managers

SAP is announcing new features for the SAP Revenue Growth Management solution, designed to improve promotion and budget management in the consumer packaged goods (CPG) sector. These enhancements use AI and SAP Cloud ERP integration to help businesses better manage finances and will be available in Q2 2025.

SAP Revenue Growth Management enhancements include the following:

  • Embedded AI
    Helps provide key account managers (KAMs) insight into planning, actuals, and settlement data, allowing KAMs to make more accurate financial predictions and adapt promotion plans.
  • Access to more detailed revenue, margin, ROI, volume, and profit and loss data
    Helps KAMs and sales managers understand account performance and make informed decisions about trade promotions.
  • Integration with SAP Cloud ERP
    Can improve customers’ visibility into promotion investments and prevent overspending.
  • Direct connection to sales, demand, and supply processes with SAP Integrated Business Planning
    Allows promotion data to be transferred for more accurate demand and supply forecasts. Integration with SAP Analytics Cloud provides budget plans, further streamlining business processes.
  • Fund management capabilities
    Will help companies avoid overspending on trade promotions. Budgets can be set at both customer and product levels, aligning with financial planning.

SAP Integrates Enterprise Service Management with SAP Business Suite Solutions

SAP Enterprise Service Management offers a streamlined issue-resolution experience by connecting employees to the right resources across departments like sales, marketing, security and compliance, finance, HR, procurement, and more. SAP Enterprise Service Management, with its newly AI-fueled support services, is now available across SAP Business Suite offerings:

  • SAP Human Capital Management Core
    SAP Enterprise Service Management helps improve HR professionals’ efficiency by helping them find answers instantly through self-service options and using AI to route more complex issues to appropriate specialists. By reducing the number of repetitive administrative tasks, HR teams can focus on more complex and strategic topics.
  • Finance
    SAP Enterprise Service Management delivers AI automation that streamlines the resolution of accounts receivable and accounts payable inquiries, disputes, and discrepancies among stakeholders. By enhancing transparency and productivity, it accelerates resolution, reduces errors, shortens accounts receivable turnover, and improves cash flow.
  • Customer experience
    SAP Enterprise Service Management centralizes AI-driven processes for sales inquiries and support, from marketing to the deal desk, boosting close rates and shortening deal cycles.

SAP Partners Support Customers Cloud Migration and Extend SAP Business Suite Benefits

New and expanded SAP partnerships will advance the benefits of SAP Business Suite to specific industries, market sectors, and lines of business. These will provide customers with additional innovations to help modernize processes, improve compliance, and achieve better business outcomes with less complexity.

Accenture and SAP Join Forces to Create a Pathway to the Cloud for Organizations Pursuing High Growth

Accenture and SAP have launched ADVANCE, creating a pathway to the cloud for organizations pursuing high growth with annual revenue of up to US$5 billion. ADVANCE brings together the power of SAP Business Suite and Accenture’s industry expertise to create more connected, intelligent, and responsive enterprises solutions that leverage AI to help companies modernize faster, provide contextual data insights, and achieve predictable outcomes. ADVANCE will be generally available in the United States in H2 2025 with additional rollouts to follow. Learn more.

SAP NS2 and Google Cloud to Deliver SAP Cloud ERP Private with ITAR compliance

In partnership with Google Cloud, SAP National Security Services (SAP NS2) plans to launch International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) compliance for SAP Cloud ERP Private on Google Cloud using Assured Workloads. This expands on the existing ITAR-compliant portfolio of SAP solutions available via SAP NS2 on Google Cloud. Learn more.

Icertis and SAP Deepen Partnership to Accelerate Time to Value with AI-Enabled Contract Intelligence

Icertis, a leader in AI-powered contract intelligence, has announced plans to make Icertis Contract Intelligence for the SAP Ariba Contracts solution available as a solution extension. This milestone builds on the long-standing partnership between SAP and Icertis, helping to enable faster product deployment and time to value for customers with one-stop licensing, deeper preconfigured product integrations, and an improved user experience.  General availability is expected Q3 2025. Learn more.

SAP and J.P. Morgan Launch Integrated Banking Services in the Cloud

SAP and J.P. Morgan have announced a new collaboration to embed banking services into SAP Cloud ERP, which will provide joint customers with access to cloud-ready and AI-enabled payment and treasury capabilities.

By leveraging the SAP Multi-Bank Connectivity solution and SAP Business Technology Platform, this collaboration aims to modernize the treasury experience, streamline financial operations, reduce fraud, and accelerate the adoption of cloud services. Additionally, corporate finance teams will be able to utilize Joule Agents to help reduce manual work and errors so finance departments can more efficiently manage their resources.

Various capabilities are currently available, with additional capabilities to be rolled out in 2025 and 2026. Learn more.

Business Technology Platform

SAP Business Technology Platform helps customers innovate while transitioning to the cloud. The SAP Build solution is now infused with AI to supercharge developer productivity and offers new capabilities that make it easier for developers to create AI agents. SAP Integration Suite offers new, AI-assisted features to predict and analyze API usage trends, streamlining operations and spotting issues before they lead to financial loss.

New AI Capabilities and Enhancements Boost SAP Build

SAP announces significant enhancements to SAP Build, its application development and automation solution that provides developers with a comprehensive suite of low-code, pro-code, and generative AI tools.

Joule Studio in SAP Build Makes It Easier to Create AI Agents

Joule Studio, part of SAP Build, provides a dedicated environment for customers to create, deploy, monitor, and manage custom skills for Joule (available at the end of Q2 2025) and AI agents (available in Q4 2025) with low-code, no-code capabilities. Complementing built-in features in Joules, Joule Studio integrates with both SAP and third-party applications, giving customers the ultimate flexibility to craft business-ready agents.

  • Skill builder capability
    Design custom skills that execute predefined tasks within conversations, triggered contextually by user intent. These skills produce specific results, configurable to the customer landscape. Skills can leverage other SAP Build components such as prebuilt automations and custom applications, access to third-party integrations, and AI models.
  • AI agent builder capability
    Create custom AI agents that can execute processes and workflows with varying adaptability and self-healing capabilities. Rather than following a set of prescribed instructions, agents leverage the ‘thinking’ aspects of LLMs to figure out how to solve a problem, as well as accessible tools and APIs to augment their solution. Grounded in customers’ business data and SAP Knowledge Graph, these agents can deliver precise outputs and business-centric outcomes, accommodating human inputs throughout the workflow.

New AI Capabilities for Developers

Available in Q3 2025, SAP announces new Joule capabilities for developers in SAP Build. These AI-assisted capabilities help empower developers at any skill level to build applications more quickly and easily:

  • New AI capabilities for SAP Build Work Zone
    Employees can work smarter with quick access provided by Joule to relevant apps, tasks, and processes from one central place. Users can further use Joule to query documents using document grounding capabilities, create new documents, and summarize them for relevant information needs. By providing AI responses based on SAP-relevant data from SAP Build Work Zone, employees can save time and stay productive.
  • New ABAP AI capabilities
    Whether it's migrating custom SAP ECC code to SAP Cloud ERP to maintain a clean core or adapting existing legacy code to ABAP Cloud model standards, these AI-driven enhancements can help developers be more productive and deliver precise outcomes faster.

Expanded SAP Build Capabilities Help Customers Extend SAP Business Suite

  • Lobby for SAP Build capability
    An enhanced lobby for SAP Build serves as the central entry point for developers and business users to readily access, create, and streamline extension projects. The lobby will help simplify development, lifecycle management, and governance across all SAP projects, including ABAP, Java, JavaScript, and low-code-based development. Generally available now.
  • Extensibility wizard in SAP Business Suite
    This guided experience helps users jump-start creating extensions for SAP Cloud ERP. Developers can create and deploy applications more simply using the SAP Fiori UX and use application context to quickly develop and deploy UIs. This extensibility wizard will be made available in SAP SuccessFactors solutions in H2 2025, providing a guided experience to create extensions, with features similar to the extensibility wizard in SAP Business Suite. Generally available now.
  • Integration with SAP Business Data Cloud
    This integration will enable developers to natively discover SAP Business Data Cloud data products directly within the service center for SAP Build. Real-time visibility into available business data is enabled through up-to-date virtual tables in SAP HANA Cloud. Developers will also be able to leverage SAP Cloud Application Programming Model in SAP Build to create custom applications that integrate with data products and supplement SAP Business Data Cloud Intelligent Applications. This streamlined integration helps accelerate application development and empowers end users with richer data and deeper insights. General availability expected in H2 2025.
  • Event-driven applications and extensions
    Developers can build more responsive and scalable solutions with the combined power of SAP Build, the advanced event mesh in SAP Integration Suite, and SAP Cloud Application Programming Model. A wide range of event sources will be supported, allowing streamlined and dynamic interactions across systems. General availability expected in H2 2025.

Simplified Pricing and Packaging

Available now, customers can take advantage of the simplified pricing and packaging in SAP Build to help extend SAP Business Suite. This new pricing and packaging across SAP Business Suite allows developers to choose the right tool for every job—low-code, code-first, or AI—without managing multiple licenses.

SAP Integration Suite Accelerates Productivity with New AI Capabilities and Enhancements

SAP Integration Suite is an integration platform-as-a-service (iPaaS) that helps organizations connect their applications, data, and AI so developers can build automated, end-to-end business processes that unlock business value. SAP is introducing significant enhancements to SAP Integration Suite, including embedded AI capabilities and new feature updates:

  • New user experience for SAP Integration Suite
    Developers can utilize AI capabilities within a new UX for SAP Integration Suite supporting more effective development, configuration, migration, testing, and workload monitoring. New capabilities will enhance overall productivity and operational excellence. Generally available now.
  • AI adapter
    Customers can leverage a new AI adapter to design more impactful integration workflows with their own LLMs or the LLMs provided by SAP AI Core infrastructure. The ability to connect multiple LLMs across environments gives customers the flexibility to make their integrations of business applications and data even more intelligent. General availability expected Q2 2025.
  • AI-assisted API trends and predictions
    Customers can leverage AI-assisted API trends and predictions to analyze historical API call volumes, which forecast trends and provide insights into traffic patterns. By predicting potential anomalies that might result in financial loss, customers can proactively adjust their strategies, improving their resilience and competitive edge. General availability expected Q2 2025.
  • New integration adapters
    A new set of integration adapters include IBM MQ, Google Cloud Storage, Google Pub/Sub, Salesforce Pub/Sub, NetSuite, Anaplan, Snowflake, Amazon DynamoDB, AWS Eventbridge, Coupa, HubSpot, Jira, Microsoft Azure Cosmos DB, MS 365 Teams, MS 365, and more. Generally available now.
  • SAP Business Accelerator Hub
    The hub provides new prebuilt business accelerators and the ability to quickly search and access AI-specific APIs, events, and integrations. The hub enables customers to monitor API and event usage through AI agents that proactively identify anomalies such as security, performance, and unauthorized access. Generally available now.

SAP HANA Cloud Enhancements Support Customers’ Modernization Efforts

SAP HANA Cloud is a multi-model database with industry-leading performance and capabilities, such as the vector and knowledge graph engines that enable developers to build intelligent applications. SAP announces multiple new capabilities, available Q4 2025, to accelerate customers’ modernization path to SAP HANA Cloud.

  • Customers can leverage self-service technology to selectively migrate SAP HANA database objects to SAP HANA Cloud. This helps accelerate and simplify clean core deployments in the cloud while greatly reducing time to value.
  • SAP HANA Cloud functionality provides users with enhanced monitoring of consumption, cost visibility, and financial governance. This fine-level granularity of insights empowers companies to predict and optimize their IT spending.

SAP Customer Identity and Access Management Now Available in SAP BTP

SAP BTP now includes  SAP Customer Identity and Access Management solutions. This multitenant, cloud-native software is critical to a successful data strategy, enabling organizations to effectively capture and manage customer and partner data, while enhancing security and privacy and delivering personalized experiences. With SAP Customer Identity and Access Management, customers can uphold stringent security standards while accelerating growth. SAP Customer Identity and Access Management is now available through the SAP BTP Enterprise Agreement.

Services from SAP BTP Expand to Hyperscaler Marketplaces

Services from SAP BTP are planned to be available on hyperscaler marketplaces in H2 2025, including Amazon Web Services, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure.

Read this blog to learn more about SAP Business Technology Platform news

Business Transformation Management

SAP innovates across its Business Transformation Management solutions. Deeper integration of WalkMe solutions with SAP Business Suite improves efficiency, user experience, and ROI from SAP investments. Now SAP Signavio can more deeply understand and assess business process challenges and identify inefficiencies. New AI-assisted architecture guidance from SAP LeanIX automatically checks enterprise architecture for potential improvements and links them to concrete steps customers can enact.

SAP Announces New AI Capabilities Across the Business Transformation Management Portfolio

SAP introduces new AI features across the Business Transformation Management portfolio, including SAP Signavio, SAP LeanIX, and WalkMe solutions. These three solution areas work together to help IT and business leaders more easily manage their entire transformation journey, from quickly identifying and quantifying the potential value of transformation to securing user adoption.

New AI Assistance for SAP Signavio

General availability for the following latest capabilities is planned for Q4 2025:

  • AI-assisted transformation advisor
    Analyzes financial and other business-related documents while spotting opportunities for innovation and process optimization that transformation leads can act upon.
  • AI-assisted process conformance check
    Extends the reach of process conformance checks to include the use of unstructured sources, eliminating the need to create process models up front. Process conformance checks enable process analysts to spot deviations between their real-life business process and business rules more quickly and extensively.
  • Process context analyzer
    Leverages user-experience data and feedback to analyze business process efficiency. This helps enable process analysts to combine operational process events with user experience data to gain actionable insights, driving both process improvement and increased end-user satisfaction.
  • AI-assisted process analyzer
    Enables process mining for business users, reducing the need for deep analytical skills. Now, users can ask questions in natural language and receive immediate insights that can inform business decisions.

SAP LeanIX Supports Agentic AI and Delivers AI-Driven Architecture Optimization

  • Centralized AI agent inventory and governance
    Establishes SAP LeanIX as the single source of truth for an organization’s AI agents. Learn more about the AI agent hub in SAP LeanIX solutions.
  • AI-assisted architecture guidance
    Enables organizations to continuously scan their enterprise architecture and identify areas for improvement; and can provide insights into how to capitalize on these improvements. This helps organizations reduce risk, optimize costs, and accelerate transformation initiatives. General availability is planned for Q3 2025.

WalkMe Solutions Enhance AI Assistance for Cross-App Intelligence

  • Cross-app intelligence
    Always-on AI assistance in WalkMe solutions will be enhanced through better recommendations based on the patterns of users’ interactions as they move across applications and workflows. The new feature combines cross-application visibility, screen-level understanding, and memory of past context to proactively suggest the next best actions to users. General availability is planned for Q4 2025.

SAP Signavio Showcases New Features to Drive Process Excellence

SAP announces a slate of new SAP Signavio product capabilities that will enable customers to more deeply understand and assess their business processes, including automated root cause analysis, application lifecycle management (ALM), new support for corporate sustainability initiatives, and more.

  • Automated root cause analysis (RCA)
    Provides process analysts with a more effective way to identify the factors impacting specific process metrics. Using RCA, analysts can better understand why process performance indicators are off target, test plausible hypotheses in the data, and rank the findings by improvement potential. This can drastically increase customers’ precision in identifying the source of inefficiencies and help eliminate the need for manual investigation. General availability is planned for Q2 2025.
  • Value analysis for the SAP Signavio Process Transformation Manager solution
    Helps systematically quantify the potential value associated with improving specific business processes, making it easier to develop business cases for transformation initiatives. Already a feature in the SAP Signavio Process Intelligence solution, this capability is now also available in the SAP Signavio Process Transformation Manager and SAP Signavio Process Insights solutions, making it accessible to a wider range of business users. General availability is planned for Q2 2025.
  • Enhanced integration between SAP Signavio with SAP Cloud ALM
    Offers near real-time mapping of ALM data into business processes within SAP Signavio. Planned innovations focus on extending lifecycle control, introducing business-driven, fit-to-standard workshops, and harmonizing process hierarchies for cohesive process modeling. General availability is planned for Q4 2025.
  • Enhanced integration between SAP Signavio and SAP Solution Manager
    Enables faster, easier, and more accurate data synchronization between the two solutions. This planned innovation also offers broader synchronization, covering collapsed subprocesses, accurate process identification, and enhanced mapping flexibility. General availability is planned for Q4 2025.

Sustainability Impact Analysis

To help businesses streamline sustainability processes, strengthen regulatory compliance, and drive sustainability at scale, SAP is embedding sustainability impact metrics—such as the ability to track and analyze carbon emissions across business processes—into the SAP Signavio Process Transformation Suite.

General availability for the following capabilities is planned for Q4 2025:

  • Access to SAP Signavio Value Accelerators package
    Will help deliver prebuilt process models and industry best practices, helping businesses efficiently manage regulatory-specific processes and scale sustainability initiatives.
  • SAP Signavio Process Intelligence
    Helps analyze business processes and identify opportunities to improve sustainability management, exploring synergies with SAP Sustainability solutions.

SAP LeanIX Introduces New Features and Deeper Integrations to Drive Cloud Transformation

SAP LeanIX introduces expanded product capabilities and further integration across SAP solutions. These product updates help organizations build an IT architecture that supports their business transformation goals and gives IT leaders enhanced visibility into their application landscape.

New Features Help Streamline Technology Investments

General availability for the following capabilities is planned for Q3 2025:

  • The SAP LeanIX meta models serve as the blueprint for understanding the relationships among an organization’s strategy and technology components. They will be expanded with additional fields to help organizations evaluate the total cost of ownership (TCO) for their technology assets.
  • Enhanced dashboards and reporting will make it easier for executives to visualize the TCO of applications within their IT landscape.
  • Ability to adapt calculations enables adding and editing calculations associated with cost fields to help businesses make more precise portfolio management decisions.

Deeper Integration Across the SAP Portfolio

SAP LeanIX will enable increased transparency and collaboration across the SAP ecosystem. The new integrations will help accelerate and de-risk transformations and prepare organizations for continuous innovation. With greater visibility of the current state across their SaaS applications and process landscape, customers can better optimize their enterprise architecture to map their journey to SAP Business Suite, with the following new and enhanced integrations:

  • SAP Signavio integration for process hierarchy and variants, generally available Q2 2025
  • WalkMe solution integration for SaaS discovery and usage insights, generally available Q3 2025
  • SAP Cloud ALM integration for interface discovery, generally available Q3 2025
  • SAP BTP integration that enables the automatic discovery of extensions and services and provides increased transparency, generally available Q3 2025

New Features Help Maintain Standards and Minimize Risks

SAP LeanIX can now help organizations discover and track self-build software on software development platforms like GitHub. This provides enterprises with a more comprehensive view of the custom software components they have developed and identifies where and how custom code interacts across their IT landscape. This will enable companies to maintain a consistent overview and minimize associated risks, facilitating better management and oversight. The feature will be generally available by the end of Q2 2025.

SAP Introduces New WalkMe Digital Learning Solution and SAP Business Suite Integration

SAP announces an AI-assisted, contextual digital learning solution that will be part of the WalkMe portfolio. Additionally, WalkMe Digital Adoption Platform will be integrated with SAP Business Suite, providing in-app guidance to help IT professionals navigate complex software tasks in real time.

AI-Assisted Digital Learning Solution Will Bridge the Gap Between Knowledge and Action

Available by the end of 2025, this innovation enables customers to smoothly integrate WalkMe solutions into employees’ workflows, delivering intelligent, adaptive learning experiences when and where users need them.

Unlike traditional e-learning solutions that provide assistance in parallel, this new capability facilitates learning exactly when and where it’s required. The capability will accelerate software adoption, optimize productivity, and drive continuous workforce transformation.

WalkMe Solution Integration with SAP Business Suite Supports Adoption

To boost user adoption, WalkMe solutions will be integrated across solutions in SAP Business Suite including SAP SuccessFactors HCM, SAP Ariba, and SAP Cloud ERP. By providing in-the-moment guidance, AI-enabled recommendations, and automation, these integrations will accelerate application onboarding, help ensure employees maximize the full potential of SAP solutions, and help companies achieve ROI from their SAP investments.

  • WalkMe for SAP SuccessFactors HCM
    An AI-assisted digital adoption solution provides employees with in-app guidance and automation for critical HR workflows, from onboarding and requesting time off to learning new processes and more. For HR teams, click-by-click data can provide valuable insights that help optimize workflows, while no-code content creation tools and preconfigured templates make it easier to customize in-app guidance. This helps offer support to employees when and where they may need it. WalkMe solutions help organizations to accelerate adoption, boost employee productivity and improve the overall employee. This integration is generally available now.
  • WalkMe Premium for SAP Ariba solutions
    This integration helps accelerate adoption of new procurement technologies by offering in-app prompts for tasks like creating purchase requests, managing approvals, or launching sourcing events. The real-time, step-by-step user guidance is especially valuable during system updates, process changes, or onboarding of new buyers and suppliers. This integration is generally available now.
  • WalkMe solution integration for SAP Cloud ERP
    This integration helps simplify the transition to cloud ERP by guiding users through complex workflows and automating critical tasks directly within SAP Cloud ERP. By embedding real-time guidance, task automation, and AI-driven validations into the workflow, the integrations with WalkMe solutions helps reduce friction during implementations, accelerate process adoption, improves data accuracy and compliance, and support a clean core strategy by minimizing the need for custom development and ongoing enablement. This integration is expected to be generally available in Q4 2025.

Services and Support

SAP’s expanded services and support offerings provide a more flexible, end-to-end experience for organizations moving to the cloud. This includes newly launched tiered service plans for SAP Business Suite, new AI-assisted services, and enhancements for customers of SAP Cloud ERP Private solutions.

SAP Modernizes Services and Support for Customer Cloud Adoption

To help customers more easily adopt SAP Business Suite, SAP will introduce a modern, tiered services and support engagement model to guide customers as they transition to the cloud and adopt the latest SAP innovations.

This newly simplified engagement model will offer three success plan options:

  • The foundational plan
    Expands the support that comes with every cloud license subscription to include enhanced onboarding. Customers of SAP Cloud ERP Private solutions will also have access to transformation preparation services.
  • The advanced plan
    Includes the foundational plan plus a higher degree of ongoing service, advice, guidance, and solution activation to help customers reach successful transformation to the public cloud with a clean core.
  • The max plan
    Includes all offerings in the foundational and advanced plans and a tailored approach to guide complex, enterprise-wide transformation.

Additionally, customers will be able to extend their planned experience by adding streamlined professional services and application management to help adopt and operate their solutions. The new engagement framework is planned to be generally available in January 2026.

Existing contractual engagements between SAP Services and Support and customers remain unaffected.

Read this blog to learn more about the modernization of the services and support engagement framework

SAP Enhances RISE with SAP Journey with New Tools and Services

SAP introduces new enhancements to services and support for customers on the RISE with SAP journey. These updates will help drive transformation with expert-level guidance and strategic insights.

Evolution of RISE with SAP Methodology

RISE with SAP Methodology provides customers with a structured approach to adopt SAP Business Suite solutions leveraging a standardized framework, an integrated toolchain, and expert guidance.

SAP announces the following enhancements to RISE with SAP Methodology, which are available now:

  • Updates to the discovery phase
    Helps define a solution scope that best meets customers’ unique business needs.
  • A project workspace in SAP Cloud ALM
    Helps customers develop multiple, combinable road maps for adopting different line-of-business solutions.
  • Increased onboarding offerings
    Includes enablement on Business Transformation Management and SAP BTP solutions including SAP Build, which are requirements for customers’ cloud transformations.

In Q3 2025, the methodology will also include Joule, giving customers new AI-assisted capabilities that can provide 24x7 expert guidance, actionable insights, and the ability to automate project tasks.

New Transformation Preparation Service Supports Cloud Transformation

SAP is introducing a new transformation preparation service as part of RISE with SAP Methodology, available today, that helps customers build a tailored transformation road map to support their evolution to SAP Business Suite. Included in the SAP Cloud ERP Private package, this offering accelerates time to value with set tools and established governance models.

SAP Announces New AI-Driven Services and Support

SAP announces new AI-driven services that, taken together, will help customers get more value from SAP investments.

Available today, SAP is also introducing new support to help businesses to create customer-specific AI solutions that address their individual business needs. Built on proprietary data and tailored algorithms, these AI solutions can deliver faster time to value and competitive differentiation by training models on customer-specific data and building innovations designed for customers’ specific business scenarios.

New services and support solutions include:

  • AI assistance from SAP MaxAttention
    Provides customers with an AI-guided solution designed to optimize their SAP solutions, helping improve their quality and performance. This enhancement will generate AI-enabled insights and suggest actions to improve areas such as data-capacity excellence, adoption potential for SAP Cloud ERP Private, and operational excellence for SAP BTP. The AI-guided recommendations walk customers through implementation steps, helping them detect and resolve issues earlier, improve system performance, unlock unused functionality, and accelerate innovation adoption. The service is available today, for limited customer release.
  • New AI management system certification
    Will help customers enhance trust and transparency in AI adoption by upholding industry standards and ethical AI practices, while reducing risks. General availability expected in Q4 2025.
  • AI activation service
    Can quickly enable Joule in the customer’s landscape and helps ensure smooth setup. This service is generally available today.
  • AI customer center of expertise service
    Will help businesses establish and operationalize a center to drive continuous AI adoption and optimization. General availability expected in Q2 2025.
  • Security dashboard for SAP Cloud ERP Private
    Offers a security use case as a service for porting and a use-case development platform that alerts users to vulnerability, compliance, and security of end points, network systems, and SAP applications. General availability expected in Q3 2025.

SAP Accelerates Cloud Transformation with New Transition Guidance

SAP introduces transition guidance, an integrated app that orchestrates transformation-related assets, tools, and services to help customers accelerate their cloud transformation. With Joule as the entry point, personalized guidance and actionable recommendations can be tailored to an individual’s transformation objectives. Transition guidance packages bring together capabilities from the following SAP solutions:

  • SAP Joule for Consultants
    Maps out interfaces, migrates data, and automates testing.
  • SAP Signavio
    Delivers in-depth insights into current business processes, optimizing efficiency and decision-making.
  • SAP LeanIX
    Provides a thorough understanding of the business implications of cloud transformation, including architecture, risks, and dependencies.
  • SAP Cloud ALM
    Provides highly integrated tools and services to support data-driven decision-making processes, and project planning, execution, and testing throughout the entire transformation.
  • Joule for developers
    Helps adapt custom ABAP development tools, optimizing business applications for the cloud.

Transition guidance will release the first key features by the end of 2025, with more functionality coming throughout 2026.

Read the overview press release

With Business AI everywhere, SAP aims to boost business productivity by up to 30 percent.

Read more

    Discover current and past news guides from the SAP Sapphire, SAP Connect and SAP TechEd events, featuring product, partner, and other key announcements.

Overview

SAP Products A–Z

SAP 3D Visual Enterprise 

Accelerate decision making and boost product quality and productivity – with SAP software that integrates 3D visualization and business data.

https://www.sap.com/products/scm/product-visualization.html

ABAP 

SAP BTP ABAP environment is the Platform-as-a-Service for ABAP developers. A cloud-optimized ABAP platform based on SAP HANA serves as a development and runtime environment for cloud apps utilizing the service framework of SAP Business Technology Platform.

https://www.sap.com/products/technology-platform/abap/environment.html

ABAP environments 

SAP BTP ABAP environment is the Platform-as-a-Service for ABAP developers. A cloud-optimized ABAP platform based on SAP HANA serves as a development and runtime environment for cloud apps utilizing the service framework of SAP Business Technology Platform.

https://www.sap.com/products/technology-platform/abap.html

SAP Absence and Leave Management 

Stay compliant with 400+ U.S. and Canadian leave regulations. Automate eligibility, manage cases, and protect your organization from fines and litigation.

https://www.sap.com/products/hcm/leave-absence-management.html

SAP Access Control 

Discover how the SAP Access Control application streamlines managing and validating user access to on-premises financial management applications and data.

https://www.sap.com/products/financial-management/access-control.html

SAP Access Violation Management by Pathlock 

Enhance regulatory compliance and risk management with SAP Access Violation Management by Pathlock to centralize governance and minimize access violations.

What is Ariba

What is Ariba?

Ariba is a longtime leader in spend management software that was acquired by SAP in 2012.

Explore SAP Ariba

What is Ariba?

Ariba is a longtime leader in spend management software that was acquired by SAP in 2012.

Today, the SAP Ariba spend management solution portfolio is empowering companies to move faster and spend better.

 

The solutions connect millions of trading partners worldwide to SAP Business Network to enable direct, intelligent connections that redefine how organizations communicate and get work done:

  • Buyers can manage the entire purchasing process to achieve sustainable sourcing savings and control spending while building healthy, ethical supply chains.

  • Suppliers can connect with profitable customers and scale existing relationships to simplify sales cycles and improve cash control.

What makes SAP Ariba solutions so different?

SAP Ariba solutions integrate with other SAP procurement solutions to provide tools, services, and expertise to reduce financial and operational disruptions, meet workforce and customer needs, and lower supplier risk and market uncertainty.

  • Deeper understanding of spend: Manage the complexities of all kinds of spend by putting decades of SAP expertise and specific solution capabilities to work.

  • Real business process integration: Implement a smooth source-to-pay process that’s integrated with your pay processes, back-end systems, and trading partners to deliver optimal value.

  • Worldwide business network that connects you with everything: Evolve past portals to engage in collaborative commerce with a global community of current partners and millions of potential new suppliers.

  • Problem-solving today with an eye on tomorrow: Stay resilient with a future-focused platform of SAP solutions that can scale and grow with your company, no matter where it stands today or goes tomorrow.

Why SAP Ariba solutions?

When you’re working hard to keep your business moving forward in a world of rapid and constant change, procurement makes it possible.

Procurement and transformation

  • Procure to pay: Automate your entire purchasing lifecycle and give users one place to search for indirect goods and services.

  • Catalogs: Define, validate, and enrich catalog content with enterprise-grade content management tools to give employees a simple way to buy.

  • Guided buying: Guide employees to use preferred suppliers, processes, and policies, resulting in more user adoption and compliant spend.

  • Spot Buy: Enable a cost-saving source for indirect goods, simplifying one-off or emergency purchases that are too costly and time-consuming to source.

Procurement solutions from SAP can help you:

  • Rethink the experience to remove obstacles and let intelligent technologies do more of the work

  • Link categories together globally, managing spend centrally while adapting to market requirements

  • Create deeper collaboration with trading partners while sharing data and insights securely

Learn more about SAP solutions for procurement 

Direct and indirect materials sourcing

  • Strategic sourcing: Combine sourcing with contracting and supplier lifecycle management to reduce costs and risks.

  • Product sourcing: Equip teams to establish high-value sourcing agreements that meet the needs of automotive and industrial manufacturing companies.

  • Contract management: Speed up contract cycles and reduce administrative and legal costs when you rid yourself of paper and ink.

  • Spend analysis: Organize spend data from across different systems and identify and prioritize sourcing opportunities more easily.

Sourcing and contracting solutions from SAP can help you:

  • Manage and optimize your sourcing, contracting, and spend analysis processes for various types of spend

  • Speed up sourcing cycles and create competitive, best-value agreements for sustainable savings

  • Optimize cost, mitigate supply chain risk, and fully realize negotiated savings

Learn more about SAP solutions for sourcing and contracts 

Centralized information and risk management

  • Supplier information: Get a unified supplier record with a high degree of confidence in the data.

  • Lifecycle and performance management: Integrate with procurement to drive spend to preferred suppliers and scale compliance for your entire supply base.

  • Risk management: Make risk assessment and due diligence part of the source-to-pay process, and tailor risk views and alerts to your business and role.

Supplier management solutions from SAP can help you:

  • Source and procure the right products from the right suppliers at the right time and the right price

  • Reduce risk at each step, from onboarding and qualification to segmentation and performance management

  • Prevent savings leakage by making supplier qualification and segmentation part of the buying process

Learn more about SAP solutions for supplier management 

Automated receipt, processing, and payment

  • Network-based business rules: Alert suppliers about errors and prevent incorrect invoices from entering your process workflow or back-end system.

  • Touchless processing: Capture and automate the processing of invoices, including PDF invoices, non-PO invoices, and invoices for complex services. 

  • Configurable workflow: Use preconfigured, best-practice workflows right away, and enjoy drag-and-drop functionality for simple and quick modification.

  • Stronger compliance: Employ two-way (PO-invoice), three-way (PO-goods receipt-invoice), and four-way (PO-goods receipt-contract-invoice) matching.

Invoice and payment solutions from SAP can help you:

  • Increase the accuracy of invoices to speed up both processing and payments

  • Pre-validate invoices so missing or incorrect information is addressed and exceptions are few

  • Free your staff from time-consuming processes to focus on strategic initiatives

Learn more about SAP solutions for invoice and payment management

products/acquired-brands/what-is-fieldgl.body:
What is SAP Fieldglass?

What is SAP Fieldglass?

SAP Fieldglass helps organizations quickly manage the external talent and services they need to stay competitive while maintaining control over costs and compliance.

Request a demo

What are Fieldglass solutions?

Fieldglass solutions are cloud-based, external workforce management software products designed to help companies manage external workers; namely contingent workers and service providers.

External workers are essential for building a strong, scalable workforce that can adapt to shifting business demands. Using Fieldglass solutions, you can transform your external workforce into a versatile, value-driving catalyst for growth. You'll have the tools you need to source, engage, and manage external talent efficiently and securely while ensuring compliance across global markets.

Key components include:

  • Contingent workforce management: Source, onboard, and manage temporary workers with ease.

  • Services procurement: Optimize spend and performance for project-based services.

  • Worker profile management: Maintain a complete view of your external workforce.

What’s more, when you manage external labor as part of a total workforce management (TWM) strategy—one that unifies both employees and external talent into a single, holistic view—you can gain the agility, visibility, and control needed to strengthen your competitive edge.

Benefits of using Fieldglass solutions

Your organization faces growing challenges in finding and managing external talent. You need to get the right talent at the right time to every part of the business while maintaining compliance and controlling costs. When you streamline and optimize external workforce management with Fieldglass, you can plan with precision to reduce risk and costs.

Compliance and risk management

Stay ahead of changing labor laws and security requirements with intelligent automation.

Workforce visibility and flexibility

Gain a comprehensive view of your external workforce to adapt quickly to business needs.

Cost savings and efficiency

Optimize spend with automated processes and real-time analytics to make smarter decisions.

Build a workforce that’s ready to respond

Fieldglass solutions can help your organization turn its external talent into an agile, business-building resource.

Create workforce capacity on demand: Quickly source and onboard specialized skills and scale up or down as needs change.

Manage your way to the best results: Actively manage every service and contingent engagement to maximize value.

Take proactive control of compliance: Reduce risk with intelligent automated compliance tools and global localization.

Increase efficiency and reduce disruption: Automate labor rates; streamline external workforce and services processes; reduce risks; and ensure delivery of results.

What makes Fieldglass solutions different?

The market for service procurement and external workforce management software is diverse. Here’s how Fieldglass stands out:

  • Support for all categories, from field services and maintenance to engineering, construction, and corporate/professional services, to ensure end‑to‑end visibility and control across the entire external workforce landscape.
  • Smooth Integration with SAP and non-SAP ERP systems increases flexibility and reduces reliance on middleware.
  • Localized for 180+ countries and 21 languages, Fieldglass provides global reach to help ensure compliance with local labor and tax laws.
  • Sophisticated rate management can handle complex rate scenarios with dynamic lookups and effective scheduling for accurate financial planning.
  • Comprehensive analytics with real-time reporting and configurable dashboards for actionable insights.
  • Self-service capabilities enable quick, easy changes.

Get started with Fieldglass solutions

Begin your journey by streamlining external workforce management in one secure, cloud-based platform.

Explore contingent workforce management
Explore worker profile management
Explore services procurement

FAQ

Fieldglass is a cloud-based external workforce management system that helps organizations manage their contingent workforce and services procurement. It enables businesses to source, engage, and manage workers and service providers efficiently while maintaining compliance and controlling costs.

Fieldglass is used by HR, procurement, and talent management teams in organizations of all sizes and industries.

Fieldglass pricing varies based on an organization's needs. Models include annual subscriptions and consumption-based pricing. As your program scales and spend increases, unit costs typically decrease.

Key benefits of using Fieldglass include faster sourcing and onboarding of contingent and service workers, reduced risk through automated compliance, and cost savings and efficiency with real-time analytics and process automation.

Fieldglass provides real-time, configurable reporting with cross-module data integration, enabling comprehensive analytics with minimal technical effort.

products/ai-platform/cloud-migration.htm.body:
Enable cloud migration

Talk to an expert

Why migrate to cloud solutions and SAP Business AI Platform?

SAP Business AI Platform is where your data, processes, and AI unite to deliver the Autonomous Enterprise.

Optimal timing for cloud migration

With maintenance ending for SAP Business Warehouse (SAP BW), SAP Process Integration, SAP Process Orchestration, and SAP Business Planning and Consolidation (SAP BPC) in December 2027, now is the time to take advantage of SAP's free assessments and proven migration programs.

Intent-based business process execution

SAP Business AI Platform shifts your teams from navigating dashboards to expressing intent while AI assists in orchestrating actions, decisions, and outcomes across your entire enterprise.

One trusted data foundation for every AI decision

SAP Business Data Cloud unifies and governs business-critical data, giving every AI agent the context needed for reliable, auditable business outcomes.

Move faster with AI governance built in from the start

SAP Business AI Platform combines deep process context, unified data, and purpose-built models with enterprise governance, so you can build and integrate AI that understands your business—not just your prompts.

SAP makes your move easy with expert guidance

Free assessments for the data and integration landscape and the SAP Customer Evolution kit provide good starting points for your move to the cloud.

Start your AI journey before migration is complete

With SAP's AI-first strategy, you start benefiting from AI during your migration, making the transformation journey itself a direct source of competitive advantage.

How it works

Every migration path follows a structured three-step approach. SAP guides you through each phase with tools, expertise, and best practices.

STEP 1

Assess

Inventory your on-premises landscape. SAP's automated tools extract scenarios, evaluate complexity, and estimate the effort required for each migration object.

STEP 2

Plan

Design your target architecture and migration plan. Classify objects for migration, retirement, or rebuild. Prepare your team with SAP Learning courses and documentation.

STEP 3

Move

Migrate using SAP's automated tooling. Validate results in your cloud environment. Complete your migration with minimal business disruption.

Choose your cloud migration journey and start on your defined pathway.

Analyze and simulate outcomes with analytics and predictive capabilities. Drive better decisions with a modern cloud planning solution.

SAP offers complimentary, no-obligation assessments for the migration paths below. Get an expert analysis of your current landscape and a personalized road map to the cloud.

Explore the SAP Customer Evolution Kit

products/artificial-intelligence/ai-agen.description: See how Joule Agents and Joule Assistants help companies analyze data, automate workflows, and support informed decisions autonomously across business domains.
products/artificial-intelligence/ai-agen.body:
Artificial Intelligence
Overview

Joule Agents

Joule Agents and Joule Assistants

Accelerate outcomes with context-aware agents and assistants that know your work and your business.
Request a demo

Streamline workflows end to end with context-aware agents and assistants

Joule Agents are AI agents with business process expertise that reliably execute multistep tasks across SAP and non-SAP systems. Joule Assistants use deep role and process context to coordinate Joule Agents and execute complex workflows across the business.

Drive enterprise-scale productivity with:

  • Prebuilt agents that combine SAP's unmatched depth of business process expertise with Model Context Protocol (MCP) and Agent2Agent (A2A) protocols to execute reliable, cross-system workflows.

  • Assistants that understand your role and business context, so they know exactly which agents to coordinate to get the job done.

  • Agents and assistants that give you visibility and control because they have proper oversight and governance built in.

Accelerate complex workflows

Reduce time spent on multi-step workflows by up to 75% to speed business execution, boost productivity, and free up teams for high-value work.*

Realize AI value at scale

Deliver enterprise-wide results with expert agents and assistants that reliably connect and optimize business-critical processes across functions.

Execute with oversight and governance

Achieve results with agents and assistants that keep humans in control and actions authorized, observable, and traceable, backed by enterprise-grade security and centralized governance.

WEBCAST
Adapt sourcing at the speed of business with Joule and SAP Ariba

Explore how Joule’s Sourcing Agent helps managers quickly refine sourcing events, navigate geopolitical risks, and stay ahead in dynamic supply chains.

Watch on demand

AI that delivers real business impact faster

Accelerate business outcomes with agents and assistants grounded in deep context, industry knowledge, and enterprise-grade governance.

Business Process Grounding

Built around your role

Assistants are aligned to your specific business roles and processes, making them accurate at inferring user intent and knowing which AI agents to use.

Codified SAP domain expertise

Joule Agents execute specific business processes, turning SAP's deep domain knowledge into repeatable, reliable automation.

Built-in enterprise knowledge

SAP Knowledge Graph is built on years of SAP expertise, giving Joule Agents a deep understanding of enterprise processes and relationships to orchestrate work across end-to-end workflows.

Joule Agents access the most relevant data in your business to see the big picture

Connected enterprise data

SAP Knowledge Graph delivers a deep understanding of enterprise data and processes, giving specialized agents the context they need to reason, decide, and execute across end-to-end workflows.

Unified, business-ready data

SAP Business Data Cloud gives Joule Agents access to trusted enterprise-wide data, enabling them to make better decisions and execute complex workflows with greater accuracy.

Scale AI from simple tasks to autonomous business operations

By understanding the full business landscape—not isolated data points—Joule Agents and Joule Assistants can take on larger, cross-functional challenges and help drive more autonomous, intelligent operations.

SAP AI Agent Hub helps you effectively discover, deploy, and govern Joule Agents with:

  • A centralized dashboard that provides a clear, unified view of all agents in use—including custom and third-party agents. 

  • Resources that help IT managers discover agents for more use cases and explore their value.

  • A KPI dashboard that offers insights into governance, adoption, and ROI.

Explore SAP AI Agent Hub 

Agents only execute within user permissions

Each agent gets a unique identity for reauthentication at every step and all traffic flows through one agent gateway, so agents can only execute what the end user has permission to do directly.

Defense-in-depth with a secure-by-default runtime

At runtime, agents operate in a hardened sandbox with layers of defense, including content filters, resource limits, and connectivity restrictions.

Human oversight is built into the architecture

Oversight options help augment rather than replace human judgment. High-risk processes always require explicit approval and all agent activity is logged and traceable.

Read how SAP secures AI in the Autonomous Suite 

Design, deploy, and manage custom AI agents

Joule Studio: Build trusted custom agentic solutions

For unique business needs that go beyond prebuilt agents, use Joule Studio. Create AI agents by describing desired business outcomes in plain language. Your teams can build with low-code or pro-code and leverage agent frameworks such as LangChain and LlamaIndex for full flexibility and control. 

Explore Joule Studio 

SAP AI Agent Hub: Centrally manage and govern AI agents

Discover, inventory, and govern agents across your landscape with a single, vendor-agnostic command center. Gain full visibility into performance, understand business impact, and ensure every agent operates within its architectural and organizational context.

Explore SAP AI Agent Hub

Build, deploy, and scale AI agents across your enterprise

Watch the video

Explore how Mota-Engil eliminated manual goods receipt entry and accelerated invoice clearance with a procure-to-pay smart agent built on SAP BTP, SAP Business Data Cloud, and Joule.

Learn how Uniper used Joule Studio to turn complex procurement processes into simple, conversational actions for faster decision making, enabling employees to focus on more-strategic work.

Watch the video

Discover why organizations are accelerating AI investment and how leaders are overcoming data, governance, and workforce challenges to maximize AI ROI.

Read the 2026 research report 

Resources

Learn more about Joule Assistants and Joule Agents

Discover what assistants and agents are, how they work together to drive business value, and see them in action across lines of business.

Take the next step

See SAP solutions in action

Get a closer look at how SAP solutions work across your business processes.

Request a demo

Frequently asked questions

Joule Assistants are AI assistants aligned to your business roles and processes, so they understand the context you're working in. You tell an assistant what you want to accomplish in natural language, and it coordinates specialized AI agents to complete it. Assistants turn isolated tasks into connected workflows that help you efficiently complete work because proper oversight and governance are built in.

Joule Agents are ready-to-use AI agents that provide business users with decision support and task automation requiring non-deterministic workflows. Joule Agents choose from a large set of tools (including Joule skills, other agents, and third-party applications) to act on their plans, reflect on the results to draw conclusions, and make recommendations. Grounded in SAP Knowledge Graph and SAP Business Data Cloud, Joule Agents uniquely understand your data and processes to act reliably through business applications.

Joule Assistants coordinate Joule Agents through deep role and business context. Once directed by the assistant, agents connect relevant data, tools, and applications to perform specific tasks such as analyzing data, triggering actions, interacting with systems, and executing steps in a workflow.

Use prebuilt Joule Agents when your needs align with standard business processes in areas like finance, HR, or procurement, and where you want fast time-to-value with enterprise-grade security and SAP-managed updates. Create custom agents in Joule Studio when your workflows are unique or specialized enough that standard agents only partially address your needs, keeping in mind that you take on full lifecycle responsibility for anything you build. Most organizations adopt a hybrid approach, leveraging prebuilt agents for common processes while using Joule Studio to extend or build agents where their unique business context justifies the investment.

What is SAP Joule for Consultants?

SAP Joule for Consultants is a conversational AI solution that accelerates SAP projects with expert guidance from SAP's most exclusive and up-to-date knowledge base.  It is built for internal IT teams and the consulting partners that support them.

Accelerate project delivery by up to 14%*

  • Boost productivity for consultants and in-house teams of all experience levels. 

  • Save time with fast, accurate answers on demand. 

  • Reduce rework with decisions grounded in SAP best practices. 

  • Accelerate time to value across every project.

See how consulting firms use SAP Joule for Consultants 

Impact for every team

Gain real AI value, backed by numbers

Save up to 1.5 hours per person per day on knowledge searches.* Cut ABAP code interpretation time by up to 40%.* Reduce redesign effort by up to 50%.*

Elevate your IT team's impact

Equip your team to do more projects internally. Strengthen their collaboration with consulting partners on the strategies and decisions that influence project outcomes.

Amplify your firm's service quality

Free consultants to spend more time executing and less searching. Drive client outcomes with higher-quality decisions. Accelerate time to value for clients undertaking complex cloud transformations.

Exclusive SAP expertise, more accurate answers

Extensive, current, and gated content

  • Over 12 terabytes of expert-curated SAP knowledge, including over 100 SAP certifications.

By guiding each role where they work, SAP Joule for Consultants and SAP Joule for Developers help teams deliver SAP projects faster, reduce rework, and realize business value sooner.

Responsible AI

SAP Business AI delivers ethical, secure, and compliant AI to future-proof your organization.

View SAP's AI Ethics Handbook

Responsible AI at SAP is based on three pillars—ethics, security, and compliance

At SAP, we care deeply about the impact of AI and are convinced that AI unlocks boundless potential for businesses, governments, and society. However, AI may also create economic, political, and societal challenges, depending on how it is used and implemented. This makes responsible AI crucial to foster sustainable innovation, create better products, and deepen customer trust.

SAP delivers AI based on the highest ethical and security standards and streamlines compliance organization-wide, and has achieved the ISO 42001 certification for AI governance and key SAP Business AI products.

Ethics defines our values, security protects your systems and data, and compliance ensures legal alignment

AI Ethics

AI Ethics at SAP is guided by a multi-stakeholder approach and a strong governance framework, coordinated by the AI Ethics Office. These efforts are anchored in SAP’s Global AI Ethics Policy and development standards that drive responsible AI innovation.

Learn more 

AI Security

AI security is crucial to helping protect data from potential threats. Advanced security measures let you use AI technology without compromising data integrity.

Learn more 

AI Compliance

AI Ethics

Human-centered innovation that augments human capabilities and ensures human agency.

At SAP, we deliver ethical AI through human-centered innovation that augments human capabilities and is guided by 10 principles.

Upholding the highest ethical standards, SAP’s AI Ethics policy is based on the 10 guiding principles of the UNESCO Recommendation on the Ethics of Artificial Intelligence as well as other frameworks and development standards. This set of values guides us to create human-centered AI systems that help respect and augment humans, while remaining under human oversight and following the other guiding principles.

SAP is proud to have been recognized multiple times as a leader in responsible AI by several organizations including the World Benchmarking Alliance, sustainableIT.org, and others.

Building on this foundation, AI Ethics at SAP will continue to evolve – creating more effective, innovative, and ethical outcomes worthy of trust and tailored to our customers’ needs.

SAP’s AI Ethics Principles are based on an internationally recognized framework

  • Proportionality

  • Safety and security

  • Fairness and non-discrimination

  • Sustainability

  • Right to privacy, and data protection

  • Human oversight and determination

  • Transparency and explainability

  • Responsibility and accountability

  • Awareness and literacy

  • Multistakeholder and adaptive governance and collaboration

Every SAP AI use case has to go through an AI Ethics impact assessment process

  • The process is orchestrated by the AI Ethics Office.

  • Use cases are classified into different risk categories based on the impact assessment process.

  • Depending on the risks involved, use cases go through several review steps before a decision is reached.

  • The AI Ethics Office also provides guidance for implementing AI Ethics in AI system development. 

Learn more about our AI Ethics principles and governance structure​ 
View SAP’s Global AI Ethics Policy 
View SAP’s AI Ethics Handbook​

Operationalizing AI Ethics across our business

Our internal Global AI Ethics Steering Committee and our external Global AI Ethics Advisory Panel are part of our governance bodies.

We remain firm in our commitment to prioritize data privacy and security as we release new AI capabilities.

Your data remains safeguarded within our ecosystem

Our AI solutions are developed responsibly

We stand by the security of your data

  • We employ advanced data security measures to protect your personal data at all times with encryption, tenant isolation, data masking, filtering, etc.

AI Compliance

At SAP, we believe that compliance is necessary to enable safe use of AI for our customers.

SAP derives its AI Governance framework based on best practice standards, guidelines, regulations, and frameworks such as the EU AI Act, NIST AI RMF, NIST CSF, ISO 27002, ISO 42001, ISO42005 and the SAP Global Security Policy.

SAP is ISO/IEC 42001 certified

  • The certification covers SAP internal AI governance and key solutions such as Joule, SAP AI Core, and SAP AI Launchpad.

SAP is NIST certified

  • SAP has achieved Tier 3 alignment with the NIST Cybersecurity Framework (CSF v1.1), underscoring strategically managed, enterprise-wide cyber risk practices.

  • For customers, this translates into enhanced protection of critical data, greater transparency into SAP’s security practices, and access to shared insights and a reusable assessment framework.

FAQ

Customer data can be used to improve existing AI features and functionalities of the SAP cloud service to which the customer has subscribed, subject to the terms of the customer agreement, including the general terms and conditions for cloud services and the data processing agreement.

 

Customer data can be used by SAP to develop new AI features and functionalities, subject to the terms of the product development schedule, which is part of the customer contract.

 

Customers who agree to the product development schedule can monitor in which SAP solutions their data might be used and opt out in the SAP for Me interface.

Customer data remains safeguarded in SAP’s ecosystem. Customer data entered in SAP AI technology is treated in the same manner as all customer data that is entered into the cloud service. Therefore, all rights, duties, and obligations around customer data set forth in the cloud agreement with SAP are honored.

 

Specifically for the usage of data to create new features and functionalities, as per the product development schedule, only authorized named persons in SAP can access specific data.

SAP stands by the security of customer data and does not share customer data with other vendors for the purpose of training or improving their large language models (LLMs) or image models.

When customers use an SAP AI technology that leverages a third party–hosted foundation model, their data is sent to the model provider for processing only and is not stored or otherwise retained by the model provider.

At the end of the agreement, SAP deletes the customer data remaining on servers hosting the cloud service, unless applicable law requires retention. Retained data is subject to the confidentiality provisions of the data processing agreement. Customers can export their data before the subscription term expires.

 

The general terms and conditions for SAP cloud services describe the handling of customer data, and the data processing agreement further describes the processing of personal data.

To promote ethical use of AI, SAP requires that all its user interfaces display a short AI notice when the user is using an AI feature or its result has been created by AI. More complex or high-risk AI features show a more detailed acknowledgment. Icons or messages also let customers know when they are triggering an AI-based action.

Customers seeking official responses to AI security inquiries should refer to the SAP Trust Center or get in touch with their SAP account executive.

SAP is dedicated to aligning our operations with the new regulatory standards outlined in the EU AI Act, which will come into effect in phases. Accordingly, the EU AI Act regulation for prohibited practices according to article 5 has already been implemented. We also monitor the regulatory landscape, implementing acts, and national laws of EU member states.

 

Under the supervision of the SAP Executive Board, a dedicated cross-functional team is enhancing SAP’s existing processes to establish a comprehensive classification process that ensures the fulfillment of applicable requirements.

 

As a B2B company, SAP is focused on how responsibilities and tasks are distributed along the AI value chain. SAP may take on multiple different roles within this value chain, such as provider, deployer, purchaser, or integrator of AI systems, as well as developer of our own AI foundation models.

Boost your development and productivity with SAP Domain Models—trained on SAP code, data, and processes to deliver accurate answers, optimized code, and tailored recommendations for your business.
Request a demo
Sign up for the AI newsletter

What are SAP Domain Models?

SAP Domain Models are SAP native foundation models trained on SAP code, data, and business processes that assist users with AI when querying data or developing code in SAP applications.

SAP Domain Models:

  • Are trained on SAP code, data models, and business process semantics.

  • Function as the world’s best expert on SAP business processes and code.

  • Power Joule, Joule Studio, AI agents, and SAP solutions with domain-specific expertise.

Key benefits

Get accurate answers from all SAP data

Reduce guesswork with outputs grounded in SAP data and metadata, so recommendations and actions are reliable.

Accelerate delivery and modernization of code

Speed up development, onboarding, and migrations with coding recommendations based on native SAP code and architecture.

Adopt AI with confidence

Natively operate within policy guardrails and SAP-managed governance to support secure, compliant AI—reducing risk as you automate SAP workflows.

Key features

SAP-native training data and continuous training

Models are trained on SAP code, data models, and processes to deliver the best output. Continuous training ensures transparent adoption of new data and future product directions.

Answers grounded in SAP context

Connects to SAP repositories and metadata. Uses SAP Knowledge Graph to ground outputs in relevant artifacts, improving precision for code help and process guidance.

Coding made easy

Developers can create, extend, and migrate code with guidance and support from models trained on SAP-optimized code. Code is optimized for each SAP application and for specific languages, such as ABAP.

FAQ

SAP Domain Models are AI foundation models trained and continuously updated by SAP on its code, data, metadata, documented best practices, and business processes.

General foundation models are trained on public information about SAP technology and cannot reach the depth of knowledge that an SAP-owned and trained model can have on proprietary technology.

Joule uses SAP Domain Models when users ask questions using natural language about data in SAP applications. Joule Studio uses SAP Domain Models to provide code when developers want to create new applications or extend and modernize existing ones within SAP. Initial models provide assistance for ABAP and for SAP Ariba code.

SAP Domain Models ground responses generated by AI with accurate content using SAP Knowledge Graph, live data, and historical code from SAP. They’re continuously updated to keep in line with improvements in SAP applications and changes in data models and code.

Save up to 70% of time on document processing* by integrating and matching business data with SAP applications. Use the solution to:

products/artificial-intelligence/joule-s.body:

Fully managed

SAP provisions, patches, and operates the service, so there’s no self-hosting.

Governed by default

No new contracts

The service runs on SAP Business AI Platform using your existing SAP agreement.

Frequently asked questions

An agentic workflow is a process where AI agents and deterministic steps act together across systems to reach a business goal. Unlike fixed, rule-based automation, agentic workflows:

  • Adapt in real time to data, conditions, and context.

  • Combine rules and routing with AI decision-making.

  • Act across your IT landscape to complete multi-step goals.

Joule Studio can automate business workflows that include:

  • Cross-system integration, syncing SAP and non-SAP applications.

  • Agentic process orchestration, chaining AI agents with rule-based steps.

  • Event-driven and scheduled automations, reacting to webhooks or timed triggers.

  • AI-powered content processing, providing classification, extraction, and sentiment analysis via language models through generative AI hub.

  • Custom API orchestration, connecting to external services and endpoints.

You create business workflows directly in Joule Studio, where n8n is embedded as the orchestration engine. You can:

  • Build with natural language prompts, the visual canvas, or Visual Studio Code.

  • Rely on SAP to manage provisioning, scaling, patching, and governance.

  • Authenticate with your existing SAP identity, which uses centrally managed credentials.

  • Run on cloud credits with no separate n8n license or vendor contract.

You can automate business workflows with n8n in Joule Studio across a wide array of use cases. Common categories include:

  • Agentic process orchestration, such as invoice exception handling and contract review.

  • Cross-system integration, such as employee onboarding across SAP SuccessFactors, Active Directory, and ServiceNow.

  • AI-powered content processing, such as email classification and sentiment analysis.

  • Event-driven automation, such as inventory alerts and certificate expiry checks.

  • Custom API orchestration, such as multicarrier shipping and payment reconciliation.

Nodes are the building blocks of an n8n workflow, each representing a single operation. In Joule Studio, you wire nodes together on a visual canvas. Node types include:

  • Triggers, such as a webhook, schedule, or event.

  • Actions, such as reading data, sending a message, or calling an API.

  • Logic steps, such as branching, looping, or running code.

SAP-developed nodes connect to SAP systems with zero credential setup. Additional nodes cover non-SAP services, language models via generative AI hub, and custom code.

Yes, Joule Studio workflows can run across SAP and non-SAP systems. Embedded n8n provides:

  • SAP-developed nodes for core SAP systems, including SAP S/4HANA, SAP SuccessFactors, SAP Ariba, and SAP Concur.

  • A curated and expanding set of n8n's most-used non-SAP nodes.

  • Model context protocol (MCP) support, so agents can discover and invoke external tools.

Embedded n8n in Joule Studio supports four primary patterns:

  • Workflow-to-system orchestration: Cross-system integration orchestrates data and actions across SAP and non-SAP applications (such as employee onboarding sync).

  • Agent-to-workflow delegation: An AI agent delegates a multistep task to an n8n workflow for execution (such as blocked invoice resolution).

  • Workflow-to-multi-agent fan-out: A scheduled workflow fans out tasks to parallel AI agents and aggregates results (such as multi-agent contract review).

  • Extension hooks: Prehooks and posthooks act on agent responses for content processing (such as sentiment escalation).

You should choose from these complementary capabilities based on the nature of the automation:

  • Use embedded n8n for AI-agent orchestration, cross-system integration across SAP and non-SAP systems, and workflows that combine agentic reasoning with deterministic logic.

  • Use SAP Build Process Automation for structured, human-centric processes—including approvals with forms, decision tables, robotic process automation (RPA) bots for desktop and legacy UI automation, and scenarios requiring built-in task inboxes via SAP Build Work Zone.

Frequently asked questions

You can interact with agents you build in Joule Studio directly through Joule Work. Ask a question or make a request and Joule Work routes it to the right agent automatically. Agents can also reach you proactively by sending notifications through workflow connectors or A2A connections.

The difference is that SAP-delivered Joule Agents and Joule Assistants are already available across SAP applications, including HR, finance, procurement, and supply chain. These agents are ready to deploy with no additional development required.

 

Custom agents are for processes that are unique to your business: your approval workflows, your data structures, and your rules. Joule Studio is where you can build those.

 

If a prebuilt agent covers your use case, start there. If it doesn't, Joule Studio is your path.

Agents you build in Joule Studio are grounded in SAP Knowledge Graph, which means they understand your SAP data relationships, object models, and process structures before you write a single line of code.

 

Joule Studio also gives you the option to extend SAP-delivered agents, providing you with a template to start your AI project.

 

Conversely, most agent builders give you a blank canvas, so you have to replicate all the business context to harness the agent.

You don’t necessarily need to manually write code to build a custom agent. Business users with any level of technical development expertise can use Joule Studio to create a working agent.

 

Business analysts can describe what an agent should do in plain language directly in the Joule Studio web UI. The platform handles the spec, the code, and the deployment.

 

Developers who want full control can build pro-code in Visual Studio Code, Cursor, or Cline using the Joule Studio CLI with any agentic framework. Both paths produce the same deployable artifact.

Joule Studio handles governance for custom agents through SAP AI Agent Hub, which is included with Joule Studio for up to 500 agents. Every agent you deploy is automatically registered, observable, and governed from day one. Agent actions are logged under a distinct agent identity, separate from user actions, so every action is attributable in the audit trail. You can manage SAP-built, custom, and non-SAP agents from a single entry point.

No, Joule Studio doesn’t require SAP LeanIX or SAP Signavio to work—they’re both optional. SAP LeanIX surfaces your business architecture and SAP Signavio provides process conformance data, making your agents significantly more capable. Both are optional amplifiers, not prerequisites.

The Joule Studio design-time environment is free of charge. Running agents on the Joule Studio managed runtime is free through 2026. After that, consumption-based pricing applies. Visit the Joule Studio pricing page for more details.

FAQ
