topics/events/connect/innovation-news-gu.body:
SAP Connect 2026 Innovation News Guide

Explore news and innovations announced at SAP Connect 2026 that are bringing the SAP Autonomous Enterprise to life — including Joule, SAP Autonomous Suite and SAP Business AI Platform.

Published on October 6, 2026

About this Guide

The SAP Connect 2026 Innovation News Guide illustrates how SAP’s vision of the Autonomous Enterprise is becoming a reality, enabling various personas to work alongside AI assistants and agents across end-to-end business processes. SAP Autonomous Suite offerings in the finance, spend, supply chain, human capital management and customer experience domains help organizations use AI to streamline operations, enhance productivity and drive greater business resilience.

The Autonomous Enterprise comprises the Joule Work capability, SAP Autonomous Suite and SAP Business AI Platform and includes industry scenarios that combine AI innovation with SAP's deep process and vertical expertise. Now line-of-business domains in SAP Autonomous Suite are expanding with new Joule Assistants, Joule Agents and AI capabilities — all supported by SAP Business AI Platform.

SAP Autonomous Suite assistants and agents, Joule Studio and Joule Work are delivered and activated as SAP-managed experiences through the SAP for Me portal, and are already delivering value in customer environments. Feedback and insights gained during early adoption programs have helped shape and refine the offerings. Building on this momentum, general availability for these innovations starts in October, with further innovations and capabilities as SAP continues to expand the portfolio.

Read the press release

Coverage of the Global Keynote at SAP Connect 2026.

Financial Management

New SAP Pay Solution Embeds Autonomous Payments in SAP Cloud ERP​

SAP is entering the payment services market with the SAP Pay solution, a payment service embedded directly into the workflows in SAP Cloud ERP applications. SAP Pay is powered by Tereina, a regulated payment-service provider founded in April 2026 as a wholly owned SAP subsidiary to enable SAP’s entry into the payments space.

For finance organizations, the payment process has traditionally required separate banking platforms, file transfers, third-party middleware and postpayment reconciliation — which often require time-consuming IT projects to implement. SAP Pay can help remove that complexity. When an invoice is approved in an SAP Cloud ERP application, SAP Pay automatically executes payment and reconciles it against the corresponding invoice or purchase order. This helps remove manual bank file handling, external payment processing dependencies and reconciliation delays.

The service supports payments via EFT (including ACH), wire and check, as well as stablecoin-based settlement for cross-border transactions, so that organizations can execute and reconcile payments in a single workflow. Payment processing, reconciliation, controls and auditability all occur within the ERP environment.

A global distributor of networking and wireless broadband solutions is already using SAP Pay to automate supplier and treasury payments, citing benefits such as the ability to simplify complex payment and supplier processes and help ensure timely payments.

SAP Pay is generally available now in the United States and United Kingdom.

​​Autonomous EPM Advances with New SAP Enterprise Financial Consolidation Solution

The new SAP Enterprise Financial Consolidation solution will advance SAP’s vision for autonomous enterprise performance management (EPM). Designed to provide finance organizations with a continuous understanding of performance, the new solution can free up time for finance professionals to act on insights rather than spending resources to reconcile plans, results and disclosures. This builds on the launch of the SAP Enterprise Planning solution at the SAP Sapphire event in May 2026.

Built with components in the SAP Business Data Cloud solution, SAP Enterprise Financial Consolidation will bring together statutory and management consolidation with close and disclosure capabilities. It will enable finance teams to track performance using the same governed data foundation, supporting faster decision-making, more efficient reconciliation and greater confidence in guiding business performance and regulatory reporting.

SAP Enterprise Financial Consolidation will also include two new Joule Assistants to help manage consolidation and disclosures. These assistants will use SAP-curated data products to help finance teams identify anomalies, resolve exceptions and coordinate disclosure preparation within auditable, human-supervised workflows. The assistants will also help finance teams prepare disclosures more efficiently and reduce the manual effort needed for many tasks.

Customers that already have group reporting solutions from SAP can use SAP Enterprise Financial Consolidation alongside their existing tools. The solution will be particularly useful for companies that run several different software systems — whether SAP or third-party — since it can pull financial data from any of them. This will give customers more flexibility and help protect their existing investments. For customers using other EPM software from SAP, such as the SAP Business Planning and Consolidation or SAP Financial Consolidation applications, this announcement offers a path to an AI-native EPM solution, supported by migration tooling and services.

Early adopter care availability for SAP Enterprise Financial Consolidation is planned for Q1 2027.

Autonomous Finance Expands with New Joule Assistants for Accounting, Reporting and Project Operations

The Autonomous Finance domain will expand with new Joule Assistants designed to support accounting, revenue management, financial reporting and project operations. This will build on the Joule Assistants for finance introduced at SAP Sapphire earlier this year, which use AI to automate finance processes that have traditionally required significant manual effort and cross-functional coordination. These existing assistants will also be enhanced with new, specialized agents for financial close, planning, treasury, billing, tax and receivables management processes.

Accounting and financial close

  • Overhead Accounting Assistant: will support controlling teams in maintaining allocation definitions, performing mass changes to cost and profit centers, and sustaining statistical key figures (SKFs). It will do this while analyzing allocation results and statistics to improve explainability and accelerate period-end processing.
  • Revenue Recognition Assistant: will help finance teams understand revenue-recognition configurations, calculations, posting history and document flow while categorizing business transactions across contracts for revenue recognition processing under International Financial Reporting Standard 15 (IFRS 15) and US GAAP. This supports organizations in maintaining audit-ready revenue reporting.

Revenue management

  • Pricing Assistant: will help commercial and finance teams optimize prices to meet margin and revenue objectives, respond faster to cost and market shifts, and reduce pricing operations costs.
  • Quoting Assistant: will support sales teams in creating accurate and compliant quotes. Learn more about the Quoting Assistant.

Financial reporting

  • Disclosure Assistant: will aid in automating last-mile external reporting activities spanning data sourcing, tagging, narrative drafting and publication validation. This will help reduce the effort associated with creating compliant financial disclosures.

Project operations

  • Project Management Assistant: can coordinate resource planning, milestone tracking, billing processes and expense governance, helping organizations improve project visibility while identifying risks and margin issues earlier.

SAP Early Adopter Care program availability for the Joule Assistants noted above is planned for Q1 2027.

New Joule Assistants Automate Governance, Risk, and Compliance and Support Continuous Monitoring

New Joule Assistants and Joule Agents will expand SAP governance, risk, and compliance (GRC) solutions, adding support for access, security, governance monitoring and trade compliance. These innovations can provide continuous visibility and governance for organizations using AI-driven processes and autonomous agents across finance, procurement, supply chain and other enterprise functions:

  • Access Governance and Security Assistant: will help coordinate access to onboarding, role design, privileged access management and continuous compliance monitoring across human and AI identities. The assistant extends identity governance to cover autonomous agents alongside traditional users, applying consistent access controls across all actors operating within the enterprise. Real-time security analytics help detect behavioral threats as they emerge.
  • Governance Assistant: will correlate behavior across multiple systems by connecting existing GRC solutions and surfacing risk and control signals. Rather than replacing current GRC investments, the assistant adds an AI-native layer that interprets behavioral signals, correlates risks across structured and unstructured data sources, and delivers role-based answers to business, compliance, security and finance stakeholders. This helps organizations move from periodic, fragmented oversight to continuous risk and compliance monitoring.
  • International Trade Assistant: will automate product classification, compliance documentation and sanctions screening. Early customer deployments show that this assistant will substantially reduce the manual effort involved in collecting product information and classifying trade products.

These assistants will help ensure the SAP Autonomous Suite operates safely as agents execute work across the enterprise. Rather than adding another layer of oversight, the assistants extend existing identity and GRC controls to AI directly, so agents cannot exceed defined limits or act beyond the authorizations provided by the employee who initiated the request.

General availability for the Access Governance and Security Assistant is planned for Q1 2027. General availability for the Governance Assistant and the International Trade Assistant is planned for Q4 2026.

Read the executive perspective on finance news.

Spend Management

Moody’s Risk Intelligence Embedded in SAP Ariba to Support Risk-Aware AI​

A new partnership between SAP and Moody’s Corporation is designed to support customers at a critical point in decision-making by embedding continuous monitoring of supplier risk within procurement workflows. Moody’s supplier risk monitoring data will be built into the SAP Ariba Supplier Lifecycle and Performance solution, placing real-time insights on financial health, operational risk and regulatory status at the point where procurement decisions are made.

Today, most procurement teams assess supplier risk in periodic reviews, reconciling data from disconnected third-party tools, custom integrations and spreadsheets. By the time a risk has been identified, the window to act has often closed, putting business continuity and sourced savings at stake. This new partnership will help procurement teams identify risks early and address them promptly.

To help reduce customers’ reliance on separate risk tools, SAP will embed Moody’s intelligence directly within SAP Ariba Supplier Lifecycle and Performance alongside supplier master data and performance metrics. This will provide procurement teams with a single supplier profile that unifies information regarding performance, risk and collaboration.

The integration also helps create a foundation for autonomous procurement. With Moody’s data embedded natively in SAP Ariba Supplier Lifecycle and Performance, Joule Agents can treat risk as a live signal and prompt coordinated responses. For example, if a Joule Agent detects a shift in a supplier’s financial health or regulatory status, it can flag the supplier and surface alternatives before an issue disrupts operations. People set the boundaries, but Joule Agents handle the operational complexity within them.

General availability of these capabilities in SAP Ariba Supplier Lifecycle and Performance is planned for Q4 2026.

Autonomous Spend Management Extended with the Spend Analytics Assistant and Contingent Workforce Assistant

These new Joule Assistants will help advance Autonomous Spend Management, a domain within the SAP Autonomous Suite:

  • Spend Analytics Assistant: will help procurement leaders analyze spend data to identify opportunities for cost savings, compliance, supplier consolidation and risk mitigation. Each opportunity includes an estimated impact (such as projected savings) and can be monitored over time. The assistant reviews data from a company’s ERP or other source systems, then recommends ways to improve data quality for better classification and enrichment. It also benchmarks performance against available and appropriately sourced peer group data, flagging over- and underperformance and offering insights against key measures. A built-in dashboard prioritizes qualified opportunities with supporting evidence, helping teams act faster.
  • Contingent Workforce Assistant: will give HR and procurement teams a single, connected experience to manage the contingent-worker lifecycle, from hiring and compliance to approvals and audit. It will support comprehensive visibility, flagging exceptions early — such as onboarding delays, pending approvals or compliance issues — before they affect a worker’s assignment. By surfacing actionable insights at each stage, the assistant helps teams hire the right talent, benchmark market rates and act proactively while maintaining an evidence-backed audit trail from hiring to offboarding.

Together, these Joule Assistants will help customers address the guesswork created by fragmented processes, turning disconnected spend data into actions teams can trust. While AI recommends and prepares the work, people make the final call.

General availability for the Spend Analytics Assistant is planned for Q1 2027. General availability for the Contingent Workforce Assistant is planned for Q4 2026.

New Micro-Apps from SAP Concur Help Simplify Expense Processes

SAP Concur is expanding SAP Micro-App Hub, which includes highly specialized, one-task applications that can be easily deployed. Unlike third-party apps in SAP Concur App Center, micro-apps in SAP Micro-App Hub are developed, managed and supported by SAP to address common customer requirements and operational use cases.

The hub currently includes two micro-apps from SAP Concur (digital receipt query and request ID link), with three new offerings planned:

  • Employee expense data summary micro-app: will aid users in exporting employee expense data and receipt documentation in PDF or CSV format for governance, audit and reporting purposes.
  • Permission restriction micro-app: will help organizations remove permissions associated with inactive users, supporting access-governance reviews and reducing security risks.
  • Vendor invoice query micro-app: will support bulk retrieval and review of vendor invoice images for reporting, audit and compliance activities.

These micro-apps will build on a series of AI-supported innovations introduced at the Global Business Travel Association (GBTA) Convention in 2026. Micro-apps from SAP Concur are accessible to customers using SAP Concur solutions with the Concur Advanced Care or Concur Select Care services and an active subscription for Client Web Services.

Customer adoption of the two existing micro-apps has demonstrated strong demand for these capabilities. Customer feedback has indicated that the digital receipt query micro-app can help simplify the retrieval of supporting documentation for tax, audit and compliance purposes.

The digital receipt query and request ID link micro-apps are generally available now. General availability for the employee expense data summary, permission restriction and vendor invoice query micro-apps is planned for Q4 2026.

Where to find more info:

  • Video: Watch a demonstration of the digital receipt query micro-app
  • Video: Watch demonstrations of the request ID link micro-app
Read the executive perspective on spend management news.

Human Capital Management

Innovations for SAP SuccessFactors Solutions Help Organizations Achieve Autonomous HCM

To support organizations’ Autonomous HCM journeys, SAP announced new AI-supported innovations for SAP SuccessFactors solutions that work across HR processes to help automate, redesign and reinvent work at key moments across the employee lifecycle:

  • New Workforce Planning Assistant: designed to help business and HR leaders forecast workforce capacity and capability needs, guiding the creation of meaningful and comprehensive workforce plans grounded in business strategy. It builds on the workforce planning capability in the SAP Enterprise Planning solution and uses connected workforce, contingent labor and financial data from SAP SuccessFactors solutions, SAP Fieldglass solutions and SAP Cloud ERP. The new assistant recommends the most effective mix of hiring, reskilling, redeployment and external talent, helping better align talent investments with business priorities.
  • Agentic admin console for US benefits: will support improved oversight of benefit enrollments within a single console, with built-in agentic capabilities that will be able to analyze employer plan documentation to configure benefits systems. Real-time monitoring will help surface benefit enrollment activity and exceptions directly within the console. This will help HR administrators spend less time navigating reports and investigating issues, reduce enrollment errors and manage complex enrollment periods with greater efficiency.
  • Benefits decision support tool: will help employees make better benefits choices. Built natively into the SAP SuccessFactors Employee Central solution and embedded within the benefits enrollment workflow, the tool will use employee data in the system to recommend coverage bundles that fit each employee’s needs and budget. This more personalized enrollment experience will give employees better guidance as they navigate this important decision, helping reduce the burden of poorly matched elections for employees and organizations alike.
  • Integration of the WalkMe Learning Arc solution and SAP SuccessFactors Learning solution: will help employers and employees keep pace with evolving skills and business needs. Teams can describe their learning requirements, and AI will build courses and quizzes, with the author retaining full control. Learning experiences can be created and deployed directly within SAP SuccessFactors Learning in hours, not weeks, and delivered in the flow of work across applications. This will help close skills gaps faster, keeping employees ready for what’s next.

The Workforce Planning Assistant will be available in the SAP Early Adopter Care program in Q4 2026. General availability for the agentic admin console for US benefits is planned for Q4 2026. General availability for the benefits decision support tool is planned for Q1 2027 in the United States. General availability for the integration of WalkMe Learning Arc and SAP SuccessFactors Learning is planned for December 2026.

SAP to Acquire TechWolf, Giving Enterprises Evidence-Based View of Work in the Age of AI

SAP SE and TechWolf announced they have entered into an agreement for SAP to acquire TechWolf, provider of a leading AI work intelligence platform. TechWolf gives enterprises a continuously updated view of the work their people do and the skills they have, using its proprietary data model called context graph for work. The acquisition will bring this context graph, along with TechWolf’s AI models and applied AI research team, into SAP, establishing work intelligence as a strategic SAP asset. The deal is expected to close in Q4 2026, subject to usual closing conditions, including regulatory approval. Terms of the deal were not disclosed.

Read the press release on the planned acquisition of TechWolf

Read the executive perspective on HCM news.

Customer Experience

New and Updated Assistants for SAP Customer Experience Help Improve Customer Journeys

Building on the announcement of the Autonomous CX domain at SAP Sapphire earlier this year, new and enhanced Joule Assistants for the SAP Customer Experience (SAP CX) portfolio will provide additional support for marketing, commerce, sales, service, operations, finance and compensation teams. The assistants work with SAP applications to prepare and carry out defined workflow steps across teams and functions using shared business context, including customer interactions, orders, contracts, pricing, payment history and policies. This will enable organizations to move from insight to action, while people retain responsibility for oversight exceptions and consequential decisions.

Campaign execution at scale

New capabilities for the Content Assistant and Campaign Assistant will help reduce operational effort and costs while using enterprise context and intelligence to accelerate campaign execution and workflows. This will aid in scaling personalized engagement that drives demand generation and growth.

  • Content Assistant: helps marketers assemble personalized, channel-ready content and adapt messaging and assets for each channel.
  • Campaign Assistant: activates omnichannel campaigns, informed by customer and business signals.

Billing and compensation resolution

Two new Joule Assistants will help resolve sales compensation questions and streamline service planning and operations. The assistants can also eliminate manual information-gathering for revenue and service teams, supporting faster resolution of issues.

  • Incentive Compensation Assistant: makes it easier for salespeople to raise compensation disputes and provides transparency into crediting and payment issues.
  • Service Planning and Operations Assistant: helps service teams move more smoothly from initial contact to final invoice by connecting commercial planning, logistics coordination, post-service activities and performance data in a single guided workflow.

Order processing and quote automation

New capabilities in Joule Assistants will allow commerce and sales teams to reduce the manual work required to connect customer demand and revenue execution, freeing up time to focus on customers, opportunities and growth.

  • Shopping Assistant: adds support for B2B email order processing by validating customer and product information from incoming orders and preparing orders for fulfillment. This helps organizations reduce manual order-entry effort while people remain responsible for exceptions and approvals.
  • Quoting Assistant: helps sales teams create accurate, compliant quotes and customer-ready proposals through a unified quote-to-proposal workflow. This can accelerate the sales process, shorten deal cycles and help improve quote quality and consistency.

General availability of the additional capabilities for Campaign Assistant, Content Assistant, and Shopping Assistant, along with the new Incentive Compensation Assistant, Service Planning and Operations Assistant, and Quoting Assistant is planned for Q1 2027.

​SAP Order Management Services Extended Across Complex B2B ERP Landscapes​

New capabilities in the SAP Order Management Services bundle will help organizations coordinate complex B2B orders across SAP S/4HANA and other ERP systems. Moving forward, companies can create a common order management layer across fragmented environments by connecting customer demand, inventory, pricing and order execution across multiple ERP systems without requiring lengthy ERP consolidation projects. These capabilities support SAP’s vision for the Autonomous Unified Commerce domain by bringing together order, inventory and fulfillment processes across distributed business environments — and extending SAP Order Management Services beyond traditional B2C scenarios.

The new capabilities will:

  • Manage orders across multiple ERP and business systems. Organizations can connect and coordinate orders, inventory, pricing and fulfillment across existing environments through a common order management layer, reducing the need for ERP consolidation projects.
  • Expand support for complex B2B order processes. The solution helps validate orders, check inventory across locations, coordinate transactions between business units and keep orders moving through fulfillment. This gives operations teams a clearer view of how orders are progressing, helping them monitor order integrity and resolve exceptions before customers are impacted.

AI to help teams address B2B complexity

New Joule Agents within the Order Management Assistant will support expanded capabilities in SAP Order Management Services. Embedded directly into order execution workflows, the agents will help operations teams identify and respond faster to disruptions with less manual effort.

General availability for the new capabilities and Joule Agents is planned for Q1 2027.

Read the executive perspective on CX news.

Supply Chain Management

New Joule Agents Advance Autonomous Supply Chain Management

To execute on its vision for the Autonomous Supply Chain Management domain, SAP has expanded the capabilities of the Joule Assistants announced at SAP Sapphire earlier this year. New Joule Agents will add specialized skills to existing Joule Assistants for critical supply chain tasks.

Expanded assistant capabilities will include:

  • Product Design Assistant: New Joule Agents will be able to intelligently interpret product designs, recipes and specifications and orchestrate product changes to help accelerate time to market while staying compliant.
  • Business Network Assistant: New Joule Agents will help enable smooth collaboration with suppliers and logistics partners. New capabilities will coordinate across sourcing, contracting and exception handling.
  • Supply Chain Planning Assistant: New Joule Agents will sense, simulate and resolve plan exceptions in one workspace. This helps turn supply chain alerts into decisions, while explainability capabilities will offer planners increased transparency into planning changes.
  • Manufacturing Assistant: New agent-driven execution will help organizations adapt to ever-changing plant-floor realities by detecting real-time disruptions and making autonomous corrections.
  • Logistics Assistant: Extended agentic capabilities will be able to turn logistics intelligence into autonomous optimization and execution. New agents will work across functions, including optimizing outbound warehousing, fulfillment (for example, internal stock replenishment) and transportation dispatching for distribution.
  • Asset Operations Assistant: New Joule Agents will help convert asset signals into coordinated maintenance actions and improve uptime with new maintenance request initiation, screening and simulation capabilities.

Additional SAP innovation will help manufacturing and asset-intensive industries establish more autonomous operations, including a hybrid, cloud-edge architecture for digital manufacturing and a unified user experience for asset and service management.

Customers are already experiencing benefits from autonomous supply chains:

  • A global leader in R&D-based biopharmaceuticals is using the Supply Chain Planning Assistant to enable its future operating model by helping the company detect root causes and suggest remediation. Together with automated performance tracking, the assistant creates a learning loop that provides a path toward a more autonomous and self-healing planning capability for the business.
  • A global producer of natural ingredients for the global food, beverage, and life science and nutrition industry has adopted the Logistics Assistant for issue resolution. The assistant reduced the time to identify and resolve issues, simplifying a multistep fire drill into a one-click process. This has helped the logistics team recover roughly one-third of the time once lost to troubleshooting, and the process has evolved from exception-driven to self-resolving problem management.

These customer innovations across diverse industries demonstrate how organizations are shifting from manually managing exceptions toward more intelligent, self-healing supply chain processes.

General availability for the new capabilities is planned for Q4 2026.

Read the executive perspective on SCM news.

Industry AI

Customer Co-Innovation Supports Industry AI and the Autonomous Enterprise

SAP continues to build out its Industry AI portfolio by collaborating with customers to apply AI to complex, industry-specific processes. The Industry AI portfolio is designed by SAP forward-deployed engineering (FDE) teams that work alongside customers to address their specific requirements. This approach brings together customers’ expertise with SAP’s deep understanding of industries, business processes and enterprise data, helping organizations test and scale AI-enabled workflows in real-world operating environments.

Early results show how AI can support decision-making, automate routine actions and improve resilience across critical industry operations. By focusing on industry-specific use cases rather than generic productivity tools, SAP’s approach to Industry AI helps organizations better address challenges tied to business performance.

New functionalities will be added for the following sectors:

  • Asset-intensive industries: New AI capabilities will automatically review, categorize and prioritize maintenance requests, reducing manual effort and helping organizations respond to issues faster. By improving maintenance planning and decision-making, companies can increase asset reliability, reduce downtime and optimize maintenance resources.
  • Automotive industry: A new AI-enabled 8D process can improve quality management by accelerating root cause analysis, automating reporting and continuously capturing organizational knowledge. This will help reduce the time and cost required to address defects while improving collaboration across suppliers and production teams.
  • Commodity-intensive businesses: A new solution will help speed up trading operations, using AI to convert negotiated deals into finalized contracts in seconds. This helps companies reduce manual work, improve data accuracy and execute trades faster while still maintaining strong governance and oversight.
  • Energy and natural resources organizations: A new maintenance scheduling solution will use AI to automatically create and update maintenance plans as conditions change. This will help energy and natural resources organizations prioritize tasks, deploy resources more efficiently and reduce operational disruptions. It will support more reliable operations and help lower the cost and complexity of managing critical assets.
  • Retailers: New AI capabilities will improve product and supplier data, identify assortment gaps, optimize promotions and make products easier for customers to find. This will help retailers bring products to market faster, respond more quickly to shifts in demand, and improve sales and inventory performance while maintaining appropriate business controls.

General availability of the capabilities for asset-intensive, commodity-intensive, energy and natural resources, and retail sectors is planned for Q4 2026. General availability of automotive industry capabilities is planned for the end of Q1 2027.

Read the executive perspective on Industry AI news.

Business AI Platform

SAP Reltio Unifies Application Data to Boost AI Impact​

The new SAP Reltio in SAP Business Data Cloud solution will help organizations unify fragmented data across SAP and third-party systems, providing trusted context to business applications and AI. This solution is based on technology from Reltio, which was recently acquired by SAP.

Businesses often struggle with managing fragmented records across line-of-business (LOB) applications. Customers, suppliers, products or employees (referred to as "entities" by data experts) may be represented by multiple records across various LOB applications. Each system may hold only a partial view, use different identifiers or attributes, or reflect different versions of the same real-world entity. For example, terms such as "customer" or "supplier" can carry different business meanings depending on the application or process.

AI systems don’t automatically reconcile these variances, which is required to deliver reliable results. Without holistic and consistent insight across application domains, the quality of AI and its ability to take decisive, well-informed action can be diminished.

SAP Reltio addresses fragmentation by reconciling discrepancies and delivering trusted context that can be used across an organization. This is especially important for LOB application administrators, for whom SAP Reltio can provide a trusted, unified view of these entities. This "system of context" can be used consistently across business functions and applications, including SAP and third-party applications for HR, procurement, finance, sales and more.

Data and analytics leaders can use the new solution to unite and enrich master data with context from additional domains and sources — for example, supplier data from SAP Ariba solutions — so AI agents can operate with coherent, accurate business context across the organization. This creates a trusted data foundation that enables AI to act independently, decisively and effectively to drive positive business outcomes.

SAP Reltio is generally available now.

SAP Signavio Portfolio Innovations Help Organizations Deploy Agentic AI More Effectively

The SAP Signavio portfolio will expand with new capabilities designed to help organizations measure the impact of existing agentic AI investments and identify new opportunities to deploy AI agents.

Organizations adopting AI agents at scale face a common challenge: designing, governing and operating enterprise AI agents that deliver measurable process outcomes. If they don’t have visibility into AI agent performance and the tools to measure it, organizations can find it difficult to systematically understand where AI can add the most value. The challenge deepens as AI agent deployments grow more complex; organizations running multiagent workflows often lack the means to track conformance, diagnose underperformance or understand how AI agent capabilities are being used in practice.

SAP Signavio solutions address these challenges with two innovations that give LOB teams the governance and insight needed to scale AI agents responsibly. Enhanced AI agent mining can track and analyze multiagent workflows, giving organizations deeper visibility into performance, conformance and optimization opportunities across their AI deployments. New agentic AI capabilities for process consulting will go beyond SAP-centric processes and use process mining technology for deeper analysis. This will help LOB teams identify where AI agents can create the most value, without relying on IT or external consulting to map opportunities.

General availability for these two capabilities is planned for Q1 2027.

New AI Capabilities in the WalkMe Portfolio Help Identify and Address Adoption Challenges

New AI capabilities within the WalkMe portfolio will help LOB teams identify barriers to employee adoption of enterprise software and related AI tools. This innovation can help make it easier to create in-app guidance to help users get maximum value from the technology.

Application adoption is one of the biggest challenges faced by LOB IT professionals, with employees routinely struggling to execute complex workflows across multiple applications. Similarly, companies have deployed multiple AI assistants and agents without providing employees clear guidance about how to use these tools. This can lead to poor technology adoption, wasted investment and lost productivity. Organizations need visibility into where and why problems occur to determine a clear improvement path.

New AI capabilities in WalkMe solutions address these challenges directly:

  • AI insights: will help LOB leaders pinpoint where users are struggling. Rather than relying on IT or data analysts to build reports, leaders can ask questions in plain language and instantly receive custom dashboards built from real-time behavioral data. Whether the prompt is, "Where are users dropping off in our procurement process?" or "Show AI assistant usage to support internal procurement," AI insights deliver the answers without requiring technical skills or specialist support.
  • AI authoring: will help turn insights about user pain points into action. Once a problem is identified, LOB teams no longer need to wait for developer resources or specialist authors to create in-app guidance. They can simply describe the experience they need — a step-by-step walkthrough, a tool tip or an alert — and AI authoring in WalkMe solutions builds it, ready to customize and publish directly to users.

AI-enhanced insights and authoring capabilities in WalkMe solutions can give LOB teams comprehensive control, providing both the intelligence to understand how people work across enterprise applications and AI, and the tools to scale organizations’ technology adoption.

Both capabilities are generally available now.

Where to find more info:

  • Blog: Read "The Operational Backbone of the Autonomous Enterprise"
Read the executive perspective on Business AI Platform news.

Cloud ERP

New SAP-Managed Public Cloud ERP Release Deepens Integration Across SAP Autonomous Suite

SAP advances its vision for AI-supported business operations with the latest release of SAP-managed public cloud ERP. By providing integrated business processes in a managed cloud environment, SAP helps customers reduce complexity and create a more dependable environment for AI adoption.

The release further strengthens this environment with deeper, managed integrations across SAP Autonomous Suite. This supports critical business processes by more closely integrating SAP S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition with SAP solutions including SAP SuccessFactors, SAP Ariba, SAP Sales Cloud, SAP Subscription Billing, SAP Project and Resource Management, and SAP Taulia.

Integrations are delivered, maintained and upgraded by SAP as part of a customer’s cloud ERP subscription. Subscribers automatically receive enhancements without the need for separate integration projects, system upgrade efforts or extensive regression testing. This accelerates time to value while reducing implementation and operational costs, helping organizations benefit from innovation more quickly.

By combining managed business process integration with AI-supported capabilities, SAP is providing customers with a practical path to scalable automation, faster time to value and improved business outcomes across the enterprise. Additional managed integrations are planned for future releases, further extending the reach of SAP Autonomous Suite.

Integration of SAP S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition with SAP Ariba and SAP Sales Cloud solutions is generally available now. General availability of integration with SAP Taulia solutions is planned for October 2026, integration with SAP Subscription Billing solution for November 2026 and integration with SAP SuccessFactors solutions for Q4 2026.

SAP Cloud ERP Private Increases Managed Integration Options with Joule

Customers using SAP Cloud ERP Private solutions can access new managed integration services to handle connectivity, security, monitoring and ongoing maintenance, freeing teams to focus on business priorities rather than integration complexity. This builds on existing integration with SAP Business Data Cloud and marks a key step toward the Autonomous Enterprise by enabling AI, unified data and intelligent workflows to work smoothly across finance, supply chain, HR and beyond.

Integrations are delivered and maintained by SAP as part of the subscription for SAP Cloud ERP Private, through a simple opt-in experience with the SAP for Me tool. Further extensions to SAP SuccessFactors and SAP Ariba solutions are planned for upcoming releases.

Integration with Joule is currently available through the SAP Early Adopter Care program, with general availability planned for Q4 2026.

Associate learning items with relevant skills automatically

Skill Inference for Learning in SAP SuccessFactors Learning uses AI to tag courses with skills that match learner needs. By improving search relevance and reducing time spent browsing unsuitable courses, this feature helps employees find the right training faster—and complete it more often.

Skill Inference for Learning uses AI to associate skills with learning items in bulk through the import process. This helps HR specialists maintain accurate skill tagging across large course libraries and ensures employees can discover training that directly supports their roles and growth goals.

Benefits

Detect and correct bias in workplace communications with AI

The Text Analyzer in SAP SuccessFactors Solutions helps employees write more responsibly by scanning for biased or harmful language. Using generative AI, it identifies and suggests alternative phrasing in real time, helping organizations promote fairness, compliance, and inclusion in every written interaction.

Published on December 4, 2025

Overview

The Text Analyzer in SAP SuccessFactors Solutions uses AI to review written content for bias, safety, and compliance. It detects potentially discriminatory or harmful language in feedback and communications, then suggests inclusive alternatives. This helps ensure writing across the organization remains clear, compliant, and consistent with company values.

Benefits

  • Ensure inclusive and responsible communication across teams
  • Reduce time spent reviewing feedback for compliance or tone issues
  • Promote a more equitable and transparent workplace culture

use-cases/joule-assistant/access-governa.body:
AUTONOMOUS FINANCE

Access Governance and Security Assistant

Govern every identity—human and AI—with least-privilege access by design, real-time threat detection, and audit-ready proof.

Published on October 6, 2026
Request a demo

Overview

The Access Governance and Security Assistant combines access governance and security across every identity in SAP: human, nonhuman, and AI agents. It prevents risky access, keeps systems secure, detects threats, and delivers forensic visibility into who or what performed each action—moving teams from point-in-time audits to continuous, provable oversight.

Tasks this assistant can help with:
  • Simulating role and authorization change impact
  • Detecting and explaining segregation-of-duties conflicts
  • Automating access certification and Firefighter reviews
  • Auto-generating alert-specific response playbooks
  • Aggregating related security alerts
  • Documenting user activity via AI log analysis
  • Scoring and summarizing investigations by stakeholder
  • Monitoring nonhuman and AI agent access for anomalies
Example use cases for this assistant:
  • Compliant role cleanup during migration to SAP S/4HANA
  • Time-boxed, audit-ready emergency access
  • Security weaknesses surfaced before exploitation
  • Unrelated alerts correlated into one investigation
  • Insider and privilege abuse detected through behavior analysis
  • Runtime monitoring and attribution of Joule Agent and other AI agent actions
  • Continuous audit evidence for NIS2, DORA, SOX, and the EU AI Act

Benefits

Least-privileged access by design
Automate reviews, resolve SoD conflicts, and screen Firefighter logs—reducing manual effort.

Detect and resolve threats faster
Aggregate alerts, generate playbooks, and deliver AI-scored summaries—cutting analyst time significantly.

See the threats generic SIEMs miss
Monitor SAP with native context. Surface anomalies and attacks that generic SIEM solutions miss.

Govern the whole workforce—human and machine
Extend the same controls, detection, and audit trails to AI agents and service accounts.

Agents used by this assistant

Use the Access Governance and Security Assistant to orchestrate specialized AI agents, including Joule Agents that apply SAP's access and security expertise, or custom agents you create.

Agent

Description

Access Certification Agent

Analyzes access risks and segregation of duties (SoD) violations to automate certification reviews and remediation.

Firefighter Log Review Agent

Reviews emergency-access sessions automatically, keeping privileged activity logged and audit-ready.

Security Threat Processing Agent

Aggregates alerts, analyzes human and non-human behavior, scores severity, and generates playbooks.

User Access Review Agent

Flags high-risk access outliers for targeted access reviews.

User Authorization Request Agent

Converts plain-language access needs into a least-privilege, SoD-checked request.

Frequently asked questions

  • What is SAP’s International Trade Assistant?

    The International Trade Assistant brings intelligence to trade compliance and customs processes across supply chain operations. It supports trade compliance specialists by automating product profile building and assisting with product classification to deliver accurate, audit-ready results grounded in legally binding customs standards. The assistant covers the most time-intensive trade compliance activities: HS code classification, product profile building, and sanctions screening analysis.

  • How does the International Trade Assistant work?

    The International Trade Assistant coordinates specialized agents that gather product data from multiple sources, semantically interpret it, and produce an audit-ready profile, including GRI pre-analysis. Its agents then apply this profile to recommend tariff numbers and commodity codes with full legal rationale, completing the GRI sequence.

  • Who should use the International Trade Assistant?

    The International Trade Assistant is designed for trade compliance specialists, customs classification teams, and supply chain compliance managers who are responsible for managing import/export compliance across complex product catalogs and jurisdictions. It is particularly relevant for organizations with large volumes of products requiring HS classification, those dealing with frequent new product introductions, and compliance teams that process sanctions screening hits and need to distinguish high-confidence automated resolutions from cases requiring specialist review.

  • How does the International Trade Assistant classify products with tariff and commodity codes?

    Classification begins with the International Trade Product Profile Agent, which builds a structured product profile and performs GRI pre-analysis. The International Trade Classification Agent then applies this to recommend tariff numbers and commodity codes, generating up to five ranked proposals, each with legal rationale covering GRI rules, legal notes, and official taxonomy descriptions. Trade compliance specialists review and validate the final decision, producing an auditable record and making HS code classification AI-assisted rather than fully manual.

  • How does the International Trade Assistant help handle sanctions screening hits?

    The Sanctions Screening Hit Classification Agent analyzes sanctions screening hits and distinguishes between high-confidence cases that can be resolved autonomously and those that require specialist escalation. Auto-resolved cases are documented in an audit trail. Cases below the confidence threshold are escalated to screening specialists with AI-generated reasoning, so compliance teams focus their attention on genuinely ambiguous situations rather than routine processing.

AUTONOMOUS SPEND

Sourcing Assistant

Orchestrate end-to-end sourcing from supplier discovery and event creation to bid analysis and supplier negotiations.

Published on May 11, 2026
Request a demo

Overview: Deploy agents today. Unlock even more tomorrow.

The Sourcing Assistant orchestrates the sourcing lifecycle from supplier discovery to award. It understands buyer intent; creates events grounded in contracts and past sourcing data; analyzes bids with supplier risk and market inputs; and generates counteroffers at scale. This results in agility through faster event launches and award decisions, while delivering cost savings through policy-driven negotiations.

The agents you stand up in SAP Ariba will lay the foundation for the future of procurement, and they’ll hit even harder in next-gen SAP Ariba. That's because the SAP Business AI Platform and SAP Business Data Cloud significantly sharpen agentic decision-making, amplifying the value of everything you've already launched.

  • Recommending qualified suppliers and discovering new suppliers from a network of millions

  • Recommending awards with explainable trade-offs and reasoning
  • Automating negotiation and counter-offer generation
Example use cases for this assistant:
  • Reduced manual effort in event creation and bid evaluation
  • Enhanced sourcing agility for urgent and high-volume events
  • Improved decision quality for better total cost analysis and transparent trade-off analysis
  • Automated negotiations that ensuring no savings opportunity is left on the table

Faster time to award
Compress sourcing cycles through automated event creation, bid analysis, and award recommendations.

Smarter supplier decisions
Analyze bids by supplier risk, market data, and sourcing objectives with transparent reasoning.

Stronger negotiation outcomes
Generate counteroffers focused on price, payment terms, and delivery levers based on competitive bid data.

Reduced manual workload
Eliminate event setup and bid comparison tasks with recommendations grounded in past events, contracts, supplier data, and deep research.

Supplier Management Assistant

Streamline the supplier lifecycle and strengthen relationships to enable more resilient sourcing and procurement outcomes.

Published on October 6, 2026
Request a demo

Overview: Deploy agents today. Unlock even more tomorrow.

The AI agents you stand up in SAP Ariba will lay the foundation for the future of procurement, and they’ll hit even harder in next-gen SAP Ariba. That's because the SAP Business AI platform and Business Data Cloud significantly sharpen agentic decision-making, amplifying the value of everything you've already launched.

The Supplier Management Assistant helps streamline the full supplier lifecycle by using AI agents to unify supplier data, assess performance, deliver risk-aware insights, and automate supplier collaboration. These capabilities support more informed decision-making and build more resilient sourcing and procurement processes.

Tasks this assistant can help with:
  • Finding vetted suppliers by category and region
  • Automating supplier creation, data collection, enrichment, and validation
  • Segmenting suppliers based on policy-driven orchestration of downstream procurement activities
  • Recommending best-fit suppliers based on automated screening and financial risk assessment
  • Using dynamic performance assessments and dashboards for data-driven decisions
  • Prescribing corrective action plans before performance risk materializes
Example use cases for this assistant:
  • Supplier relationship management across registration, qualification, onboarding, performance, and offboarding
  • Support for sourcing activities through supplier performance analysis and data
  • Improvement of supplier health and satisfaction to achieve customer-of-choice status

Eliminate manual and error-prone supplier data collection with automatically enriched information from trusted data providers.

Smarter supplier decisions
Enhance procurement decision-making based on clean and updated supplier performance.

Better supplier collaboration
Automate supplier data collection and related activities to improve supplier relationships.

Published on October 13, 2025

Overview

AI-assisted interview feedback insights in SAP SuccessFactors Recruiting generates summaries of candidate evaluations, including skills, competencies, and recommendations. Recruiters can regenerate insights as new feedback arrives, ensuring hiring teams have up-to-date, comprehensive views for faster and more informed decisions.

use-cases/reduce-time-spent-assessing-ca.title: Applicant Screening in SAP SuccessFactors Recruiting | SAP
use-cases/reduce-time-spent-assessing-ca.description: Use AI to match applicant skills to job requirements, reduce screening time, and make smarter hiring decisions.
use-cases/reduce-time-spent-assessing-ca.body:
Use Case

Reduce time spent assessing candidate applications by 80%

Use AI to match applicant skills to job requirements with greater speed and accuracy.

Published on May 14, 2025

Overview

AI-powered applicant screening in SAP SuccessFactors Recruiting provides visibility into how an applicant’s skills align with those required for the role. The system identifies direct skill matches, related skills, and skills the applicant may easily acquire. It extracts skills from resumes and enriches job requisitions to improve alignment—helping recruiters and hiring managers make better decisions, faster.

Benefits

  • Cut down recruiter time spent manually matching skills
  • Use AI to highlight direct, related, and potential skills from applicant data
  • Improve screening accuracy and reduce the chance of overlooking qualified talent
  • Provide hiring managers with clearer skill insights during evaluations

Business value

  • Faster applicant processing

    70% reduction in recruiter time spent reviewing and matching applications

  • Fewer delays in hard-to-fill roles

    25% reduction in time to fill roles previously delayed by imprecise screening

  • Lower bad hire rate

    3% decrease in hires with poor skills fit thanks to better skill visibility

about/agreements/sap-supplier-portal.htm.body:
SAP Supplier Portal
Overview

SAP Supplier Portal

Overview

Welcome to the SAP supplier portal, where you can find localized terms and conditions for procurement, the SAP supplier code of conduct, and other information about doing business with SAP and our affiliates. We build sustainable relationships with our suppliers to help fulfill our operational needs, stimulate economic growth in the communities we serve, and satisfy the expectations of our stakeholders.

General terms and conditions

Learn about the general terms and conditions for procurement and for the purchase of goods or services as referenced in the relevant purchase order from SAP or its affiliates. 

Learn more 

SAP supplier code of conduct

Read about acceptable conduct that SAP expects from our contractors, consultants, suppliers, vendors, and all other third-party companies that comprise SAP’s supply chain in our supplier code of conduct. 

Learn more 

SAP Global Travel & Reimbursement Terms for Suppliers

Find out about reimbursement of preapproved expenses related to business travel in our travel and expense reimbursement policy for SAP suppliers, which clearly reflects SAP’s values, strategies, and standards.

Learn more 

Supplier network for SAP Ariba solutions

Access information about conducting business with SAP using Ariba Network, a secure, global platform for exchanging business transactions such as purchase orders, invoices, catalogs, and payments.

Learn more 

Supplier network for SAP Fieldglass solutions

Identify support contacts and find answers to questions about the supplier network for SAP Fieldglass solutions.

Learn more 

SAP early payment program

We are pleased to offer SAP suppliers the ability to accelerate payment of approved invoices at a favorable discount rate. Learn how to get started.

Learn more 

In order to ensure that the business transactions between SAP and your company run seamlessly, kindly help to keep your company information up to date in SAP’s vendor master internal database.  In case of any changes in your company data (name, address, tax ID, bank account), reach out to the vendor master data team, or inform your SAP point of contact.

Email the SAP vendor master data team 

Speak Out at SAP

We rely on our employees and our ecosystem to assess every decision and action made on behalf of the organization to be legal and compliant with our Codes of Conduct and policies - as well as respectful towards people and the environment. SAP encourages you to speak out and report any breaches of the Codes, including concerns over potential violations relating to compliance, the law and/or regulations.
You can report your concern anonymously or by name. There are multiple ways of reporting a concern, so you can choose the method you are most comfortable with. All submissions and identities will be maintained confidentially to the greatest extent practical (in light of the need to perform an investigation and, if necessary, take action).

Speak Out at SAP reporting tool and country helplines

about/customer-stories/nhl.html.description: Learn how the NHL is enhancing and advancing the game of hockey with SAP solutions.
about/customer-stories/nhl.html.body:
SAP and NHL Success Story

NHL: Enhancing and advancing the game of hockey

Watch the video

Explore NHL’s journey with SAP

The National Hockey League (NHL) is focused on expanding and enhancing the game of hockey. It also aspires to reduce the League’s impact on the planet to ensure hockey thrives for generations to come. SAP technology helps the NHL move forward in new and exciting ways.

> 100

 million

annual visits by fans to NHL.com/stats.

30

 gigabytes

of puck and player tracking data instantly analyzed per game.

32

 clubs

engaged with the SAP-NHL Front Office App this season

 Over the years, the data we have collected has enabled the League to obtain significant hockey insights. These insights give the League the ability to constantly evolve and innovate the game, and that’s exactly what SAP helps us to do.
Peter DelGiaccoChief Technology Officer, NHL
The Challenge

Unlocking the power of data

Hockey is a fast-moving sport that generates a lot of data. Collecting, analyzing, and acting on that data enables the NHL to better serve its teams, engage with fans, and advance its business and sustainability goals.

 

Real-time game data helps teams, coaches, and players improve performance on the ice, while centralized player, league and club data sources support NHL Club front offices off the ice. Historical and current game stats also provide passionate hockey fans with a fun and educational digital experience. Beyond the game, operations and carbon impact data collected from its clubs and arenas help the NHL define new environmental standards and share key learnings across the League.

David LehanskiEVP, Business Development and Innovation, NHL
SAP technology helps us advance hockey in ways that are good for our teams, our Club's front offices, our fans, and the planet.
The Solution

Teaming up to support innovation on and off the ice

Enhancing the Game

In-game tracking technology captures the movements of the puck and players, every second of every game. Massive amounts of high-speed game data are processed in the SAP HANA Cloud database in milliseconds – and is pushed to other apps used by coaches, players, and fans to enhance their experiences.

 

During games, coaches and players use the SAP-NHL Coaching Insights mobile app to quickly see face-off wins per zone, player speeds, player time on ice, and more. This type of real-time game data was unattainable before and helps teams make tactical in-game adjustments on the fly.

 

Building on this powerful foundation, SAP also helps empower the NHL's strategic operations off the ice with the SAP-NHL Front Office App for iPad. This innovative app gives NHL general managers and hockey operations departments a unified view of critical data. The app centralizes information from multiple NHL sources, making it easier to manage roster planning, salary cap, and player contracts. Organized into League, Team, and Player views, the app provides comprehensive insights, enabling faster, more informed decisions that drive team performance.

 

Empowering Front Offices

SAP also helps empower the NHL's strategic operations off the ice with the SAP-NHL Front Office App for iPad and iPhone. Built on the SAP Business Technology Platform (SAP BTP), this innovative app gives NHL general managers and hockey operations departments a unified view of critical data at their fingertips – whether on the road or at the office.

 

The app centralizes information from multiple NHL sources, including official Central Registry data, making it easier to manage roster planning, salary cap, player contracts, draft analysis, and more. Organized into League, Team, and Player views, the app provides comprehensive insights, enabling faster, more informed decisions that drive team performance.

 

For the 2025-26 season, the app now includes playoff roster planning capabilities, allowing NHL hockey operation departments  to optimize rosters ahead of and during the Stanley Cup Playoffs. With new playoff salary cap rules taking effect for the first time in NHL history, the tool is also critical during key moments of the season, such as the NHL Trade Deadline and NHL Draft, when the future success of teams is defined, helping Clubs quickly capitalize on opportunities to compete at the highest level.

As you approach the Stanley Cup Playoffs, one move can not only change the result of a particular game, but the result of a season. These are high-stakes decisions that Clubs need to make, often in very little time. The Front Office App gives them the tools to make those decisions and maximize a Club’s chances for competitive success.

Bill Daly
Deputy Commissioner, NHL

Satisfying Fans

Game data also flows to the NHL.com/stats page, which is the go-to source for hockey analytics. The site runs on SAP HANA Cloud and combines real-time data with more than 100 years of historical stats. Last season, over 100 million data-hungry fans engaged with the site. Intuitive dashboards and filters make it easier for users to analyze the performance of their favorite teams and players, as well as legends from the past.

David LehanskiEVP, Business Development and Innovation, NHL
 At a high level, from an innovation standpoint, the NHL is focused on expanding and enhancing the game of hockey. For a big portion of that, we need to capture a tremendous amount of data. We need to process that data, distribute that data, and turn it into meaningful experiences.

Going Green

As a leader in the sports world, the NHL aspires to reduce its environmental impact on the planet. In 2010, the League launched its NHL Green initiative and became the first sports league in North America to voluntarily release two sustainability reports on its carbon footprint.

 

With the help of SAP, the NHL recently used SAP Business Technology Platform to create NHL Venue Metrics, an end-to-end, cloud-based platform designed to revolutionize how the League collects, analyzes, and reports on operations data across its clubs and arenas. The data will be processed through SAP HANA Cloud and visualized with the SAP Analytics Cloud solution. The insights gained will enable the NHL to define and embed sustainability best practices into its business operations and reduce its ecological impact wherever possible.

 

 In order for us to impact any change, we need to measure. NHL Venue Metrics is a perfect example of how we were able to expand SAP HANA Cloud to create a new sustainability solution for the League.
Omar MitchellVP, Sustainable Infrastructure and Growth Initiatives, NHL

Staying Ready for What’s Next

Beyond enhancing the game and front-office operations, SAP and the NHL continue to collaborate on optimizing the League's core business processes, ensuring it is future-ready. As part of its commitment to innovation and operational excellence, the NHL recently selected SAP Cloud ERP  and SAP SuccessFactors solutions. These strategic adoptions will help the League enhance its workforce management and streamline financial operations, further solidifying SAP's role as a comprehensive technology partner for the NHL's entire enterprise.

Ready to start your journey? Contact SAP to get started

SAP helps the NHL run better

Key business outcomes and benefits

  • Transformed the NHL's statistics platform to establish NHL.com/stats as the definitive destination for hockey analytics, engaging more than 100 million fans
  • Teams used the the SAP-NHL Coaching Insights mobile app an average of 22 to 23 minutes per game during the 2021-22 season
  • Had the app featured 250+ times by broadcast partners
  • Improved reporting and insights to embed sustainability into business operations and reduce environmental impact
  • Empowered general managers and hockey operations departments across all 32 Clubs with centralized data for more efficient, accurate, and real-time decision-making on rosters, salary cap, and contracts

Featured solutions and services

  • SAP Business Technology Platform connects processes, data, and experiences to achieve continued business innovation through a unified, business-centric platform, including:

SAP HANA Cloud is a fully managed in-memory cloud database that integrates data from across the enterprise, enabling faster decisions based on live data; and

SAP Analytics Cloud combines business intelligence, augmented analytics, predictive analytics, and enterprise planning into one cloud environment.

  • SAP SuccessFactors offers individualized experiences and strategic workforce planning capabilities that empower employees to reach their full potential
  • SAP Cloud ERP provides anytime, anywhere access to mission-critical business processes, offering robust scalability and continuous innovation capabilities to support ongoing business transformation

About the NHL

The National Hockey League (NHL), founded in 1917, is the second oldest of the four major professional sports leagues in North America. Today, the NHL consists of 32 member clubs, each reflecting the League’s international makeup, with players from more than 20 countries represented on team rosters.

About the NHLPA

The National Hockey League Players’ Association, established in 1967, is a labor organization whose members are the players in the National Hockey League. The NHLPA works on behalf of the players in varied disciplines such as labor relations, product licensing, marketing, international hockey, and community relations, all in furtherance of its efforts to promote its members and the game of hockey.

To accommodate the diverse financial reporting periods of our global customer base, this product follows a quarterly rolling audit cycle rather than a standard half-year cycle. Each SOC 1 audit report covers a six-month period, but reports are issued every quarter on a rolling basis, ensuring continuous coverage throughout the year. As a result, you will notice that some reports are labeled by half-year (e.g., H1 2026, covering October 1, 2025 – March 31, 2026) while others are labeled by quarter (e.g., Q2 2026, covering January 1, 2026 – June 30, 2026). This naming convention reflects the quarter in which the report is issued, not the length of the coverage period—each report consistently covers six months. This approach ensures that regardless of when your fiscal year begins or ends, a current audit report aligning with your reporting needs is always available.

about/trust-center/certification-complia.body:
SAP LeanIX SOC 2 Audit Report 2025

The SAP LeanIX Enterprise Architecture Management (EAM) enables enterprise architects to establish and sustain a transparent as-is IT landscape, plan roadmaps in the context of the business objectives, and execute transformation programs. Enterprise Architecture teams using SAP LeanIX EAM have the power to strategically support their business, make decisions faster, and efficiently mitigate technology risks. Consisting of three product modules, EAM is based on the core module of Application Portfolio Management (APM) providing real-time overviews of a company’s IT landscape and business capabilities. One optional module, Technology Risk Management, allows early detection of risks arising from obsolete IT components which impact applications. The other optional module, Business Transformation Management (BTM) helps business and IT teams to collaboratively model to-be architectures of transformation initiatives and their impacts on the IT landscape.

SAP Enterprise Cloud Services SOC 1 Audit Report 2026 Q1 / 2026 H1

To accommodate the diverse financial reporting periods of our global customer base, this product follows a quarterly rolling audit cycle rather than a standard half-year cycle. Each SOC 1 audit report covers a six-month period, but reports are issued every quarter on a rolling basis, ensuring continuous coverage throughout the year. As a result, you will notice that some reports are labeled by half-year (e.g., H1 2026, covering October 1, 2025 – March 31, 2026) while others are labeled by quarter (e.g., Q2 2026, covering January 1, 2026 – June 30, 2026). This naming convention reflects the quarter in which the report is issued, not the length of the coverage period—each report consistently covers six months. This approach ensures that regardless of when your fiscal year begins or ends, a current audit report aligning with your reporting needs is always available.

about/trust-center/certification-complia.body:
SAP Sovereign Cloud Services Australia / New Zealand SOC 2 Audit Report 2025

SAP’s Sovereign Cloud Capabilities are managed services and deployments of security-hardened SAP cloud solutions. They are designed for SAP customers who require additional assurances for their cloud workloads and cloud delivery model, including those in the public sector and regulated industries.

 

SAP Soverign Cloud is offered in the following data center locations:

  • Australia

  • New Zealand

SOC 2 reports are prepared in accordance with AT-C Section 205 and the International Standard on Assurance Engagements No. 3000. SOC 2 reports fulfill various information and assurance needs of customers and aim to place trust in SAP’s service organization systems, processes, and controls.  These reports are intended to meet the needs of a broad range of users that need detailed information and assurance about the controls at a service organization relevant to Security, Availability, and Processing Integrity of the systems that are used to process users’ data and the Confidentiality and Privacy of the information processed by these systems (AICPA, Trust Services Criteria).  Additionally, they can play an important role in the oversight of the organization, vendor management programs, and regulatory oversight.  Please note that this examination's scope does not include the controls of any subservice organizations.  SOC 2 Type 1 covers management’s description of a service organization’s system and the suitability of the design of controls at a specific point in time, whereas a SOC 2 Type 2 also includes the operating effectiveness of controls for a dedicated period of time.

 

SAP Sovereign Cloud Australia / New Zealand has prepared SOC 2 Type 2 audit report by an independent 3rd party accountant. This version of the report covers as of the audit period November 1st, 2024, to September 30th, 2025, and the trust principles Security, Availability, and Confidentiality.

 

The use of these reports is restricted. A copy of this report is available for all SAP customers and prospects with a non-disclosure agreement in place.

Request a copy of the SAP Sovereign Cloud Services Australia / New Zealand SOC 2 Audit Report 2025

SOC 2 reports fulfill various information and assurance needs of customers and aim to place trust in SAP’s service organization systems, processes, and controls.  These reports are intended to meet the needs of a broad range of users that need detailed information and assurance about the controls at a service organization relevant to Security, Availability, and Processing Integrity of the systems that are used to process users’ data and the Confidentiality and Privacy of the information processed by these systems (AICPA, Trust Services Criteria).  Additionally, they can play an important role in the oversight of the organization, vendor management programs, and regulatory oversight.  Please note that this examination's scope does not include the controls of any subservice organizations. SOC 2 Type 1 covers management’s description of a service organization’s system and the suitability of the design of controls at a specific point in time, whereas a SOC 2 Type 2 also includes the operating effectiveness of controls for a dedicated period of time.

 

SAP Sovereign Cloud UK has prepared SOC 2 Type 2 audit report by an independent 3rd party accountant. This version of the report covers as of the audit period October 1st, 2025, to March 31, 2026 and the trust principles Security, Availability, and Confidentiality.

 

The use of these reports is restricted. A copy of this report is available for all SAP customers and prospects with a non-disclosure agreement in place.

about/trust-center/certification-complia.body:
SAP SuccessFactors Human Capital Management Cloud Security Assessment (CSA) 2026

The scope of this 2026 Cloud Security Assessment covers SAP SuccessFactors Human Capital Management (HCM) deployed in Australia using the Information Security Manual (ISM) controls manual published June 2026.

 

The scope of a Cloud Security Assessment (CSA) undertaken by an Infosec Registered Assessor Program (IRAP) certified assessor includes the evaluation of the security fundamentals of SAP, and the regional deployment (where applicable) of the Cloud Service offering. The resulting attestation created by the assessor is made available as a Cloud Security Assessment (CSA) Pack to organization’s cyber security team, cloud architects and business representatives to jointly perform a risk assessment and use SAP Cloud Services securely. This CSA Pack will include the Cloud Security Assessment Report (CSAR) and any addendums, the Cloud Security Controls Matrix (CSCM) now renamed to the Cloud Controls Matrix (CCM) detailing the individual controls and the responsibilities of SAP and the cloud consumer.

 

This assessment is undertaken in accordance with the Digital Transformation Agency (DTA)’s Secure Cloud Strategy, and Australian Cyber Security Centre (ACSC)’s Anatomy of a Cloud Assessment and Authorisation Framework guidelines.  For more information see: https://www.cyber.gov.au/acsc/view-all-content/publications/anatomy-cloud-assessment-and-authorisation.

 

The use of these reports is restricted. A copy of this report is available for all SAP customers, prospects, and partners with non-disclosure agreement in place.

about/benchmark/sizing.html.body:
Sizing
Sizing

Sizing

Sizing means determining hardware requirements such as memory, CPU power, disk space, I/O capacity, and network bandwidth. It is an iterative process to translate business requirements into hardware requirements, and is usually performed early in the project.

Sizing

Helping our Customers Determine Their Hardware Requirements

Sizing means determining hardware requirements such as memory, CPU power, disk space, I/O capacity, and network bandwidth. It is an iterative process to translate business requirements into hardware requirements, and is usually performed early in the project.

The size of the hardware and database is influenced by both business aspects and technological aspects. This means that the number of users using the various application components and the data load they put on the network must be taken into account.

With the help of SAP Standard Application Benchmark results at www.sap.com/benchmark, statements can be made as to CPU consumption and memory consumption of particular software components.

For sizing we have identified three different and independent sizing models. The first two, user-based sizing and throughput-based sizing, have been implemented in the Quick Sizer.

User-based sizing
We defined three types of active users who work with the system to a different degree. Merely counting the users can be done quite easily. The estimation is quite rough as it says very little about the actual throughput these users produce.

Throughput-based sizing
This model is quite thorough because it relies on actual or on actually expected throughput. Assumptions in business terms (e.g. number of order line items per year) need to be cross-checked against the individual installation.

Customer Performance Test
The according tests are done in a customer system with customer data. The disadvantage is that conducting these tests requires considerable time and money. For further information please refer to the white paper Carrying Out Customer Performance Tests.

Greenfield sizing

If you want to size a new SAP application from scratch, use the Quick Sizer tool or apply the relevant sizing guidelines.

Learn more about Greenfield sizing 

Brownfield sizing

If you have an SAP system running that you want to extend with new functionality / additional users or migrate to SAP HANA, perform brownfield sizing.  

Learn more about Brownfield sizing 

Expert sizing

If you are working in a large company with complex business structures, and/or custom coding, perform expert sizing.

Learn more about Expert sizing
